detail.title: Online Food Delivery App Distribution and Determinants of Jakarta's Gen Z Spending Habits

publicationDetails.detailsText: Eko Retno INDRIYARTI, Michael CHRISTIAN, Henilia YULITA, Marthaleina RUMINDA, Sunarno SUNARNO, Suryo WIBOWO / Journal of Distribution Science 20-7 (2022) 73-86; DOI: 10.15722/jds.20.07.202207.73

detail.abstract: Purpose: Considering the COVID-19 pandemic and the increasing number of online food delivery applications (OFDA), this study aims to assess the distribution of the presence of Indonesian OFDA and to measure the factors that influence the spending habits of OFDA users. Research design, data and methodology: Two hundred and nine OFDA users from Jakarta's Generation Z were surveyed via a questionnaire. The data were analyzed using Structural Equation Modeling and SMART PLS 3.0. Results: OFDAs were introduced into Indonesia in the recent past with varying degrees of popularity determined by the number of downloads. Users' intention to use was not determined by the speed of the introduction of an OFDA. This study also reveals that previous experience of the service, the orientation of time and price savings had a significant effect on spending habits. A moderating role of the saving variable on time and price was not demonstrated. Conclusions: The results of the study suggest that, in COVID-19 pandemic conditions, the spending habits of Generation Z are not based on impulse, thrift, or extravagance. The pandemic shaped specific motivations in spending habits, namely prioritizing need. This study has limitations, including the small sample size and the use of internal variables.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了印尼在线食品配送应用(OFDA)的分布情况，并测量了影响OFDA用户消费习惯的因素。研究发现，在COVID-19疫情期间，Z世代的消费习惯不是基于冲动、节俭或奢侈，而是优先考虑需求。
AI.research_question: 评估印尼OFDA的分布情况，并测量影响OFDA用户消费习惯的因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 考虑到COVID-19疫情和在线食品配送应用数量的增加
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构方程模型理论框架
AI.method: 对雅加达Z世代的209名OFDA用户进行问卷调查，使用结构方程建模和SMART PLS 3.0分析数据
AI.findings: OFDA在印尼的引入时间不同，受欢迎程度各异；用户使用意愿不受OFDA引入速度影响；先前服务经验、时间和价格节省导向对消费习惯有显著影响；节省变量对时间和价格的调节作用未得到证实
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了在疫情条件下Z世代消费动机的特殊性，即优先考虑需求而非冲动、节俭或奢侈
AI.practical_contributions: 为OFDA平台在疫情期间理解用户消费行为提供了实证依据，有助于制定更有效的营销策略

title: The Great Luxury Goods Slowdown: Why €360 Billion in Sales Is No Longer Enough

detail.title: The Great Luxury Goods Slowdown: Why €360 Billion in Sales Is No Longer Enough
detail.abstract:
This paper examines the global personal luxury goods (PLG) market between 2019 to 2025, highlighting the slowdown that followed the post-COVID boom. Using secondary data from Bain & Company’s Luxury Goods Worldwide Market Study, McKinsey’s State of Fashion, company filings (LVMH, Kering, Richemont), and international trade/tourism data, the study quantifies the downturn and analyzes its drivers.
Findings show that while PLG sales peaked at €353B in 2022, the market contracted by −2% in 2024 to €363B — the first decline since 2020. The U.S., China, and Japan — together nearly 50% of global luxury demand — all weakened due to macroeconomic pressures, domestic confidence shocks, and structural generational shifts. The paper argues that the slowdown is not cyclical but structural, with implications for investors, policymakers, and brands.

AI.findings: 2022年PLG销售额达3530亿欧元峰值，2024年首次出现2%负增长至3630亿欧元。美国、中国和日本（占全球需求近50%）均因宏观经济压力、国内信心冲击和代际结构变化而需求减弱。

title: Multifunctional Management In Small Enterprises: Effective Models Of Multi-Business Governance Under Conditions Of Economic Instability
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Multifunctional Management In Small Enterprises: Effective Models Of Multi-Business Governance Under Conditions Of Economic Instability
detail.abstract:
This article explores multifunctional management as an innovative tool for ensuring the adaptability and resilience of small enterprises under conditions of economic instability. The relevance of the topic is determined by the growing demand for effective organizational models capable of integrating multiple business directions within a single enterprise without compromising the quality of management. The theoretical framework of the study is grounded in the concepts of strategic management, cross-functional leadership, and management by objectives (MBO). The article analyzes the features of centralized and decentralized management models, offers a comparative characterization of traditional and multi-business approaches, and examines the risks associated with the “all-purpose manager” syndrome and interdepartmental conflicts.

Based on a case study of entrepreneur Violetta Varha, the paper illustrates the practical implementation of a multi-business model, which includes an auto repair service, a car wash, a children's playroom, and a clothing store. The study finds that successful coordination of such business areas requires the integration of CRM/BI systems, standardization of procedures, the establishment of a unified information infrastructure, and the implementation of KPI systems for each business unit. The expediency of applying a priority matrix for the strategic allocation of limited resources in multi-business structures is substantiated.

Key tools for enhancing crisis resilience are outlined, including energy adaptation, management of “windows of opportunity,” and the implementation of digitalized logistics solutions. A hybrid management model is proposed, combining strategic centralization with operational decentralization. The article formulates practical recommendations for preventing managerial burnout, reducing internal conflicts, and ensuring systemic efficiency in multi-business management. The research findings are valuable for both scholars and small business practitioners seeking to scale their operations without losing control or compromising the quality of management.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨多功能管理作为经济不稳定条件下确保中小企业适应性和韧性的创新工具。通过案例研究展示了多业务模型的实际实施，发现成功协调需要CRM/BI系统集成、程序标准化、统一信息基础设施和KPI系统。提出了结合战略集中化和运营分散化的混合管理模式。

AI.theoretical_framework: 战略管理、跨职能领导力和目标管理(MBO)概念。分析了集中化和分散化管理模式的特点，比较了传统和多业务方法。
AI.method: 基于企业家Violetta Varha的案例研究，包括汽车维修服务、洗车、儿童游乐室和服装店的多业务模型实施。
AI.findings: 成功协调多个业务领域需要CRM/BI系统集成、程序标准化、统一信息基础设施和每个业务单元的KPI系统。提出了优先级矩阵用于战略分配有限资源。

detail.abstract: Tourism plays a crucial role in fostering cultural exchange, stimulating economic development, and strengthening global connectivity. In recent years, however, citizens of Kazakhstan have faced mounting difficulties in securing tourist visas for international travel. These challenges include increasingly stringent requirements for financial documentation, heightened security checks, prolonged processing times, and inconsistent consular practices across different host countries. This study investigates the underlying causes of these difficulties by drawing on regional statistics, international reports, and a comparative analysis of visa policies across the Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS). Furthermore, it explores the transformative potential of digital solutions-particularly artificial intelligence (AI) and eVisa platforms-in reducing bureaucratic barriers, streamlining application processes, and fostering more efficient interactions between applicants and consular authorities. By analyzing Kazakhstan's current visa landscape in the context of broader international practices, this paper highlights not only systemic barriers but also promising opportunities for innovation. The findings suggest that the adoption of digital technologies could reshape visa management, making mobility more accessible while supporting both government efficiency and citizen engagement.

title: Market Analysis Tools for Scaling Small Business Under Resource Constraints: The Strategic Approach of an Innovative Entrepreneur

detail.title: Market Analysis Tools for Scaling Small Business Under Resource Constraints: The Strategic Approach of an Innovative Entrepreneur
detail.abstract: The article investigates the strategic use of market analytics tools for scaling small businesses under conditions of limited financial, human, and technological resources. It is substantiated that in the context of economic instability and increasing competition, the effective application of analytics enables businesses to adapt to external changes, supports informed managerial decision-making, and contributes to the optimization of operational activities without the need for proportional cost increases. The study outlines a typology of analytical approaches-descriptive, diagnostic, predictive, and prescriptive analytics-and analyzes their functional role in the strategic planning of a small enterprise. A range of free and freemium tools is considered, including Google Trends, Meta Business Suite, SimilarWeb, CRM systems, and BI platforms (such as Power BI and Tableau Public), which can be implemented even by enterprises with a low level of digital maturity. Using the case of the women's clothing store UrbanLook in Uzhhorod, the study examines practical aspects of business scaling: assessing the attractiveness of locations for expansion, segmenting customers based on behavioral and demographic characteristics, optimizing procurement policies based on analytical data, and modeling energy consumption for opening a new point of sale. Special attention is given to the integration of digital tools for operational decision-making and demand forecasting, which enhances the efficiency of inventory and logistics management. It is demonstrated that market analytics serves not only as a monitoring tool but also as a foundation for building a sustainable growth strategy for small businesses. The practical significance of the study lies in the development of differentiated recommendations for the implementation of analytical solutions according to the enterprise's stage of digital maturity, ensuring flexibility, competitiveness, and sustainable development even under resource constraints. The scientific novelty consists in the substantiation of a strategic approach to utilizing accessible market analytics tools as a means of scaling small businesses under limited resources. For the first time, using a real case study, the integration of free digital solutions into the decision-making process based on multi-level analytics is demonstrated.

detail.abstract: This research investigates the dynamics of marketing communication (marcom) within Vietnamese universities, focusing on the balance between student recruitment and stakeholder engagement. The study aims to identify the key marcom activities, channels, and messaging strategies employed, assess the performance indicators and evaluation metrics, and explore how universities engage with stakeholders beyond prospective students. An indepth interview approach was employed, involving ten representatives from higher education institutions in Vietnam. The findings reveal that Vietnamese universities predominantly focus their marcom efforts on student recruitment, with a combination of digital marketing and traditional methods like open days and school visits. Enrollment figures and digital metrics are the primary performance indicators used to assess effectiveness. However, the study highlights a lack of comprehensive communication strategies that encompass broader institutional goals and stakeholder engagement. The need for a balanced approach and alignment with institutional values is emphasized to enhance overall institutional competitiveness, support strategic planning, and contribute to education management practices.

detail.abstract: Does failure in a marriage foretell a failure to repay credit? Analyzing the retail loan portfolio of a representative bank, we find no significant difference in probability of default between divorcees and others, but do find evidence for taste-based discrimination. Divorcees pay 5.8 basis points more in interest than non-divorced peers. This discrimination is greater in regions where clan culture is more dominant, and among loan officers who are male, are older, and have been longer on the job. Such discrimination is reduced if the loan officers are better educated, and if competition in local banking market is fiercer.

declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract: Voting is one of the most direct methods of participation of citizens in governance. With the heightened number of social media users, candidates resort to using this for marketing their campaigns and parties to influence voters. To develop a model of drivers and outcomes of young voters' political expression and internal efficacy, the stimulus-organism-response (SOR) model was used. The indirect effect of the impact of word of mouth and interaction on political product involvement was positive and significant. When mediated by internal efficacy and political expression, WOM correlates positively to the outcome variable, political product involvement. Therefore, political expression and internal efficacy partially mediated the relationship between social media marketing strategies, namely, WOM and interaction and political product involvement. The study tested social media marketing in the context of elections and investigated specific components of social media. The findings underscored strategies to increase youth participation in governance. It is a unique addition to the exploration of gauging citizens' needs and perspectives as springboards for pivotal government actions.

detail.abstract: This chapter explains what the Global Compact is (and what it is not). The first section introduces the basic pillars of the initiative and explores the related historical shift of UN-business relations from confrontation to collaboration. The following section discusses why there is a need for something like a global compact between business and other stakeholders. title: Development of a Composite Index for Measuring the Multiple Aspects of Food Insecurity in Urban Households: Based on the Analysis of Key Indicators

detail.title: Development of a Composite Index for Measuring the Multiple Aspects of Food Insecurity in Urban Households: Based on the Analysis of Key Indicators
detail.abstract: Food and nutrition planning is essential for achieving food security and managing related challenges, requiring a comprehensive understanding of its various aspects and an accurate assessment of the current status. Given the multifaceted nature of food security, its dimensions are interconnected, making accurate measurement challenging. This study aims to develop a composite index that simultaneously and comprehensively measures multiple aspects of food insecurity at the household level. Initially, the study analyzed key food security indicators at the household level, selecting those that appeared least flawed and most suitable for enhancing the proposed index. Indicators such as the Household Food Insecurity Access Scale (HFIAS), Household Dietary Diversity Score (HDDS), and Months of Inadequate Household Food Provision (MIHFP) were chosen for analysis, with urban households in Tabriz as a case study, providing a practical model for researchers. A theoretical Item Response Theory (IRT) model was used to analyze these indicators, with Bayesian estimation applied for accurate parameter estimation. Data consistency was verified using Category Characteristic Curves before model estimation. Moreover, the proposed composite index was validated using the Life Poverty Index, income, and other economic variables, all of which confirmed its reliability. The results of the difficulty and discrimination parameter estimation showed that HFIAS items were more difficult, while MIHFP items were less discriminatory, suggesting that MIHFP played a smaller role in assessing food insecurity among Tabriz households. Researchers are therefore encouraged to avoid one-dimensional food security assessments, choose region-specific indicators, and refine composite index to ensure applicability across diverse global contexts.

title: Integrating Machine Learning Forecasts into DCF and LBO Valuation Models

detail.title: Integrating Machine Learning Forecasts into DCF and LBO Valuation Models

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study does not involve human participants, patient data, or case studies requiring ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Traditional discounted cash flow and leveraged buyout valuation models rely on annual financial data and linear extrapolation methods, which often produce unstable forecasts and limit accuracy for companies with volatile business cycles. This study integrates machine learning forecasting techniques into established valuation frameworks using Jindal Stainless Ltd as a comprehensive case study. Our methodology employs multiple forecasting approaches including persistence models, moving averages, ARIMA, Prophet, and XGBoost algorithms applied to quarterly financial data from 2023-2025. The quarterly machine learning models, particularly Prophet, demonstrate superior stability compared to traditional annual methods, generating consistent revenue projections that eliminate negative growth scenarios common in conventional approaches. The enhanced DCF analysis yields an enterprise value of ₹33,522 crores and equity value of ₹17,463 crores, with Monte Carlo simulation providing robust confidence intervals of ₹27,716-43,950 crores at 90% confidence level. The LBO analysis reveals a 3.1x money-on-money multiple but negative 20% IRR, highlighting the distinction between equity appreciation and returns under debt constraints. Key findings indicate that quarterly machine learning forecasts provide more realistic inputs than traditional annual extrapolations, with Prophet capturing seasonal patterns missed by linear models and projecting revenue growth from ₹40,254 crores to ₹42,813 crores over 2026-2030. However, valuation outcomes remain sensitive to fundamental assumptions about discount rates and market conditions. This research demonstrates practical implementation of machine learning-enhanced valuation, showing that quarterly forecasts significantly improve stability and reliability of traditional methods while emphasizing the continued importance of human judgment for strategic assumptions and market interpretation.

AI.tldr: 本研究将机器学习预测技术整合到传统估值框架中，以Jindal Stainless Ltd为案例，证明季度机器学习预测比传统年度线性外推法提供更稳定的收入预测，改善DCF和LBO估值准确性。

AI.theoretical_framework: 传统DCF估值理论、杠杆收购(LBO)理论、机器学习预测理论(包括持续性模型、移动平均、ARIMA、Prophet、XGBoost算法)。
AI.method: 案例研究方法，使用Jindal Stainless Ltd 2023-2025年季度财务数据，应用多种机器学习预测算法与传统方法对比。
AI.findings: 季度机器学习模型(特别是Prophet)比传统年度方法更稳定，消除负增长情景；DCF分析得出企业价值33,522亿卢比；LBO分析显示3.1倍回报但-20% IRR；Prophet能捕捉季节性模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 将机器学习预测技术整合到传统估值框架中，提供更稳定的预测输入，改善估值模型的可靠性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融从业者提供实用的机器学习增强估值方法，季度预测显著提高传统方法的稳定性和可靠性，但强调人类判断在战略假设和市场解读中的持续重要性。

detail.title: Examining the Impact of Technology-Driven Recommendations on Consumer Emotions and Intentions in Online Shopping
detail.abstract: This research explores the growing importance of personalized recommendations driven by Artificial Intelligence (AI) in virtual shopping to enhance customer satisfaction and engagement. Marketers leverage these personalized recommendations to establish strong emotional connections with customers. The study aimed to validate its hypotheses, using a sample size of 495 individuals selected through convenience sampling from India's urban population. The study's findings indicate that personalized product recommendations (PPR) and personalized visual recommendations (PVR) significantly impact consumer emotions, which, in turn, influence purchase intentions. The study focused on a younger demographic to validate its hypotheses. These findings have significant implications for e-commerce, emphasizing the need for personalized online recommendations based on the prediction of human emotions. Consumer expectations have risen in the current digital landscape, requiring marketers to develop systems that combine data, algorithms, and analytics to provide real-time, one-to-one, persuasive communication across the customer journey.

title: From Sensory Cues to Action: A PLS-SEM and IPMA Investigation of Neuromarketing, Attachment, and Consumer Intentions in Microbrand Advertising
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: From Sensory Cues to Action: A PLS-SEM and IPMA Investigation of Neuromarketing, Attachment, and Consumer Intentions in Microbrand Advertising
detail.abstract: Attention is limited and expensive in the era of the internet, but microbusinesses need to translate transient, mobile feed exposures into action. This study examines how consumer-perceived neuromarketing cues (NMC)—images, color, music/sound, and movement—influence emotional arousal (EA), brand attachment (BA), and two behavioural measures: purchase intention (PI) and social sharing intention (SSI). To address the absence of evidence from microbrand, all-digital contexts, we theoretically modeled a combination model of sensory marketing, PAD affect theory, attachment-based branding, and involvement. We employed PLS-SEM to an online recall survey of 505, digitally active adults aged 18-45 who had viewed an advertisement for a small brand in the previous week. MICOM showed partial measurement invariance, allowing age-based multi-group analysis (MGA). We also performed construct-level Importance–Performance Mapping (IPMA) to facilitate effects into priorities. Results indicate BA as the most powerful direct predictor of PI and SSI. NMC has direct effects on PI but not on SSI; EA has negative direct effects on both outcomes. BA mediates the impact of NMC, partially on PI, whereas it provides full mediation on SSI, whereas EA does not go through BA. Consumer involvement (CI) increases BA's attachment to PI and SSI but decreases NMC on SSI, suggesting that highly involved consumers use less sensory intensity in deciding to share. MGA suggests NMC forms attachment more with young consumers (18–29), but with older consumers (30–45), attachment is translated into sharing. IPMA suggests NMC (highest importance, mid performance) and BA (second-highest, mid performance) are of greatest utility levers in increasing PI. Theoretically, the research explains how virtual world sensory data gets translated into relational capital via attachment. Pragmatically, it tells microbrands to invest in craftsmanship of the senses to build BA, control arousal in terms of meaning and not intensity, personalize sharing appeals via engagement, and segment creative strategy by age.

AI.method: 采用PLS-SEM分析505名18-45岁数字活跃成年人的在线回忆调查数据，进行多群组分析和重要性-绩效映射分析

detail.title: What Explains the Success of Emerging Asia’s Service Exporters?

publicationDetails.detailsText: ADB Economics Working Paper Series No. 806
publicationDetails.journalName: ADB Economics Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines the determinants of service exports in emerging Asian economies, with particular emphasis on digital services, which have experienced considerable expansion across the region. Utilizing a structural gravity model, the findings indicate that supply-side factors predominantly drive service exports growth, rather than demand factors or trade policies. An in-depth analysis of these supply-side factors underscores the pivotal role of human capital, specifically education and English proficiency, in bolstering exports, especially within the region’s digital business process services sector. Further evidence reveals that stringent regulatory environments and barriers to digital infrastructure considerably impede exports in sectors such as telecommunications, computer and information services, and other business services. Conversely, enhanced internet connectivity not only increases exports of digital services but also boosts the exports of non-digital services.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了新兴亚洲经济体服务出口的决定因素，特别关注数字服务。研究发现供给方因素（如人力资本、教育水平和英语能力）是服务出口增长的主要驱动力，而严格的监管环境和数字基础设施障碍则会阻碍出口。
AI.research_question: 新兴亚洲经济体服务出口的决定因素是什么？特别关注数字服务出口的驱动因素。
AI.motivation: 亚洲新兴经济体的数字服务经历了显著扩张，需要深入理解其出口增长的决定因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构引力模型，分析供给方因素、需求因素和贸易政策对服务出口的影响。
AI.method: 采用结构引力模型进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 1. 供给方因素是服务出口增长的主要驱动力；2. 人力资本（教育和英语能力）对数字业务流程服务出口至关重要；3. 严格的监管环境和数字基础设施障碍阻碍电信、计算机和信息服务等部门的出口；4. 改善互联网连接不仅促进数字服务出口，也提升非数字服务出口。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对新兴经济体服务出口决定因素的理解，特别强调了供给方因素和人力资本在数字服务出口中的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了改善服务出口的具体方向：投资教育、提升英语能力、改善监管环境和加强数字基础设施建设。

detail.title: Why Boards Are Asking for AI Visibility Audits: From Marketing Risk to Governance Imperative
detail.abstract: Generative AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity have become the new front door to information and commerce. Instead of browsing ten blue links, customers and investors now receive one or two brand answers. If your enterprise brand is absent-or misrepresented-in those answers, the implications are profound: lost revenue, erosion of brand equity, diminished investor confidence, and exposure to regulatory scrutiny. Boards are beginning to treat AI visibility as a strategic risk category on par with cybersecurity, compliance, and ESG. A structured AI Visibility Audit, anchored in the Prompt Share of Search (PSOS™) metric within the AIVO Standard™, provides the evidence and governance framework directors require.

AI.tldr: 本文讨论了生成式AI助手（如ChatGPT、Gemini等）如何成为信息和商业的新入口，以及企业品牌在这些AI回答中的可见性缺失或错误表示所带来的战略风险。提出了基于Prompt Share of Search (PSOS™) 指标的AI可见性审计框架。
AI.research_question: 企业如何在生成式AI时代确保品牌在AI回答中的可见性和准确表示？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI助手已成为信息和商业的新入口，企业品牌在AI回答中的缺失或错误表示会导致收入损失、品牌价值侵蚀、投资者信心下降和监管风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Prompt Share of Search (PSOS™) 指标和AIVO Standard™框架，将AI可见性视为与网络安全、合规和ESG同等级别的战略风险类别。
AI.method: 采用结构化的AI可见性审计方法，通过PSOS™指标评估企业在AI回答中的可见性表现。
AI.findings: 董事会开始将AI可见性视为关键战略风险，需要证据和治理框架来管理这一风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AI可见性作为新的战略风险类别，并建立了PSOS™指标和AIVO Standard™理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了具体的AI可见性审计方法和治理框架，帮助管理品牌在AI时代的战略风险。

title: Monetary Stabilization of a Multi-Sector Economy: Adding Words to Action?
affiliations: Banque de France and Government of Canada - Bank of Canada

detail.title: Monetary Stabilization of a Multi-Sector Economy: Adding Words to Action?
detail.abstract: In a multi-sector economy, conventional monetary policy alone is insufficient for achieving optimal economic stabilization. We examine whether a central bank can leverage private information about economic conditions to enhance policy effectiveness and improve outcomes. Our normative analysis emphasizes that the central bank should refrain from manipulating private beliefs and, if disclosure is optimal, should communicate information truthfully. However, such a communication policy is generally not credible, as even a benevolent policymaker faces sequential incentives to influence the beliefs of price-setting firms to reduce price dispersion and its negative welfare effects. In the absence of commitment, reputation becomes crucial in shaping these incentives. Specifically, a policymaker who strategically discloses information may secure significant stabilization gains during her term, but at the cost of long-term economic inefficiency.

AI.tldr: 在多元经济中，仅靠传统货币政策无法实现最优经济稳定。研究表明，央行可以利用私人信息提升政策效果，但应避免操纵私人信念，若披露信息则应真实沟通。然而这种沟通政策通常不可信，因为即使善意的政策制定者也会面临影响企业价格设定信念的动机。在缺乏承诺机制时，声誉对塑造这些动机至关重要。策略性信息披露可能在短期内获得稳定收益，但会带来长期经济效率损失。
AI.research_question: 央行是否能够利用私人信息来增强政策效果并改善经济结果？
AI.motivation: 传统货币政策在多元经济中不足以实现最优经济稳定，需要探索央行如何利用私人信息来提升政策有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于货币政策理论、信息经济学和声誉理论，分析央行信息披露的激励结构和经济后果。
AI.method: 规范性分析，研究央行在缺乏承诺机制下的信息披露策略及其对经济稳定的影响。
AI.findings: 央行应避免操纵私人信念，若披露信息则应真实沟通，但这种政策通常不可信；声誉在塑造信息披露动机中起关键作用；策略性信息披露可能带来短期稳定收益但造成长期效率损失。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对央行信息披露动机的理解，揭示了声誉机制在货币政策沟通中的重要性，拓展了信息经济学在货币政策中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行制定信息披露策略提供理论指导，强调真实沟通的重要性，警示策略性信息披露的长期代价，为货币政策实践提供参考。

title: Institutionalized Decisional Neutral Legislator System: A Solution to the Predicaments of Nepal's Transition and Constitutional Democracy
affiliations: Independent researcher

detail.title: Institutionalized Decisional Neutral Legislator System: A Solution to the Predicaments of Nepal's Transition and Constitutional Democracy
detail.abstract: This paper examines Nepal's transition from a constitutional monarchy to a republic as a case study to reveal a core predicament of modern constitutional democracy: the tendency towards "Majority Overreach" in a parliamentary system and "Government Gridlock" in a presidential system. By comparing the institutional practices of countries like the United Kingdom, Ireland, Germany, India, and the United States, this paper finds that while checks and balances from an upper house, federal structures, and the separation of powers can partially alleviate these issues, they cannot fundamentally resolve them. To address this, the paper proposes the "Institutionalized Decisional Neutral Legislator System". This system introduces Decisional Neutral Legislators who are not affiliated with any political party. These legislators do not participate in proposing bills but exercise their voting rights only during the deliberation and accountability phases. This is intended to limit Majority Overreach and prevent Government Gridlock. Theoretically, this system could act as a "fourth pillar" of constitutionalism, offering a new approach to preventing the degradation of democratic institutions at different stages of development.

AI.tldr: 本文以尼泊尔从君主立宪制向共和制转型为案例，揭示了现代宪政民主的核心困境：议会制中的"多数过度"和总统制中的"政府僵局"。通过比较英美等国制度实践，提出"制度化决策中立议员制度"作为解决方案，引入无党派中立议员在审议阶段行使投票权，以限制多数过度和防止政府僵局。
AI.research_question: 现代宪政民主制度如何解决议会制中的"多数过度"和总统制中的"政府僵局"问题？
AI.motivation: 尼泊尔从君主立宪制向共和制转型的案例揭示了现代宪政民主制度的核心困境，需要寻找新的制度设计来平衡民主效率与制衡机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宪政民主理论、分权制衡理论、议会制与总统制比较研究
AI.method: 案例研究法（尼泊尔转型案例）、比较制度分析法（英美德印等国制度实践比较）
AI.findings: 上议院制衡、联邦结构和分权制衡只能部分缓解但无法根本解决多数过度和政府僵局问题
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"制度化决策中立议员制度"作为宪政的"第四支柱"，为不同发展阶段民主制度退化提供新的防范机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为尼泊尔及其他转型国家提供具体的制度设计方案，通过引入无党派中立议员来平衡民主决策过程

title: A lender in need is a lender indeed: Role of fintech lending after natural disasters
affiliations: Xiamen University - School of Management, Maastricht University and Dongbei University of Finance and Economics

detail.title: A lender in need is a lender indeed: Role of fintech lending after natural disasters
detail.abstract: Using earthquakes as exogenous demand shocks to the credit market, we explore whether fintech lending can complement traditional banks in face of surged credit demand under a continuous difference-in-differences framework. We find that fintech loans increases significantly after earthquakes, especially in the more severely affected regions. However, the acceptance ratio and the loan rate keep stable pre and post earthquakes, so as the borrower characteristics. Notably, the increase in fintech lending is lower in places where traditional banking networks are more intensive and concentrated, and where there is a larger share of local banks. Therefore, fintech lending is especially helpful in increases people’s access to credit in areas where traditional banks are pulling back. Last, we find positive effects of fintech credit in job retention and creation after disasters.

AI.tldr: 本文通过地震作为信贷市场的外生需求冲击，研究金融科技贷款是否能在传统银行面对激增信贷需求时起到补充作用。研究发现金融科技贷款在地震后显著增加，特别是在受灾更严重地区，但贷款接受率和利率保持稳定。金融科技贷款的增长在传统银行网络密集、集中度高的地区较低，表明金融科技在传统银行撤退地区特别有助于增加信贷可获得性，并对灾后就业保留和创造有积极影响。
AI.research_question: 金融科技贷款能否在传统银行面对激增信贷需求时起到补充作用？
AI.motivation: 探索金融科技在自然灾害等外生冲击下对信贷市场的补充作用，特别是在传统银行服务不足的地区。
AI.theoretical_framework: 使用地震作为外生需求冲击，基于连续双重差分框架分析金融科技与传统银行的互补关系。
AI.method: 连续双重差分框架，利用地震作为外生需求冲击，分析金融科技贷款在地震前后的变化。
AI.findings: 1. 地震后金融科技贷款显著增加，受灾严重地区增幅更大；2. 贷款接受率和利率保持稳定；3. 金融科技贷款增长在传统银行网络密集地区较低；4. 金融科技对灾后就业保留和创造有积极影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了金融科技与传统银行互补性的实证证据，深化了对金融科技在信贷市场作用的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供参考，表明金融科技可以在传统银行服务不足地区有效补充信贷供给，有助于灾后经济恢复。

title: Forecasting Model Development: Using New Data and Methods to Predict Economic Trends. Analyzing New Forms of Economy: Studying Digital Platforms and their Impact on Labor Markets, Consumer Preferences, and Globalization
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Forecasting Model Development: Using New Data and Methods to Predict Economic Trends. Analyzing New Forms of Economy: Studying Digital Platforms and their Impact on Labor Markets, Consumer Preferences, and Globalization

declarations.declarationOfInterest: All authors of this study declare that they have no personal or financial relationships with any individuals or organizations that could have influenced or are likely to have influenced the outcome of this research. The findings presented in this work are independent and were not influenced by external funding or personal interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants or animals, and no experimental research with individuals or animals was conducted. Therefore, ethics approval from an institutional review board was not required. The study is based solely on secondary data available from open sources.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any funding from external sources or organizations. All expenses related to the preparation and publication of this study were covered by the authors.

detail.abstract: Digitalization has a profound impact on economic processes, changing the structure of traditional industries and creating new challenges for data analysis. This paper discusses the key trends of digitalization in the economy, as well as the approaches and methods of econometrics that help understand these changes. Special attention is paid to the use of econometric models to analyze data obtained through new digital technologies. Finally, the paper discusses the prospects for the development of econometrics in the digitalization era and the importance of updating economic theories in response to changes in the global economy.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了数字化对经济过程的影响，重点关注计量经济学方法在分析数字化经济数据中的应用，以及经济理论在数字化时代的发展前景。
AI.research_question: 数字化如何影响经济过程，以及计量经济学方法如何帮助理解这些变化？
AI.motivation: 数字化深刻改变了传统产业结构，为数据分析带来了新的挑战，需要更新经济理论和分析方法来应对这些变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于计量经济学理论框架，结合数字化经济的特点，探讨传统经济理论在数字化环境下的适用性和局限性。
AI.method: 采用文献综述和理论分析方法，探讨计量经济模型在分析数字化技术获取数据中的应用。
AI.findings: 数字化改变了经济结构，计量经济学方法能够有效分析数字化经济数据，但需要更新传统经济理论以适应新的经济现实。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了数字化时代计量经济学的发展方向，强调了更新经济理论以应对全球经济变化的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和企业提供了分析数字化经济数据的实用方法，帮助理解数字化对经济过程的影响。

title: An Empirical Analysis of Impacts of Babysitting Platforms on Female Employment
affiliations: Duke University

detail.title: An Empirical Analysis of Impacts of Babysitting Platforms on Female Employment
detail.abstract: Digital innovation has consistently reshaped the employment landscape, with each new wave bringing profound changes to how labor markets function. The rise of platform markets represents the latest trend in this ongoing transformation. This study focuses on the relatively unexplored area of babysitting platforms, such as Care.com, and empirically examines their effects on women's employment outcomes in the United States. Using a staggered difference-indifferences (DID) method combined with household-level data, the results show that access to babysitting platforms significantly increases women's employment probability, weekly working hours, and annual earnings. The research demonstrates that digital platforms can reduce barriers for women entering the labor market. The study not only contributes to a broader understanding of the platform economy's positive externalities but also suggests that these platforms could serve as innovative, market-based solutions to close the gender wage gap and promote more equitable labor outcomes. As digital transformation continues to evolve, the insights gained from this study offer valuable guidance for policymakers and platform designers aiming to create inclusive and flexible platforms that empower women.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了保姆平台对女性就业的影响，发现这些数字平台能显著提高女性的就业概率、工作时间和收入，有助于缩小性别工资差距。
AI.research_question: 保姆平台（如Care.com）如何影响美国女性的就业结果？
AI.motivation: 数字创新不断重塑就业格局，平台市场是最新趋势，但保姆平台对女性就业的影响尚未得到充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字创新与就业转型理论，平台经济理论，性别与劳动力市场理论
AI.method: 采用交错双重差分法（staggered DID）结合家庭层面数据
AI.findings: 使用保姆平台显著提高了女性的就业概率、每周工作时间和年收入
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对平台经济积极外部性的理解，揭示了数字平台如何减少女性进入劳动力市场的障碍
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和平台设计者提供了创建包容性平台的指导，平台可作为缩小性别工资差距的市场化解决方案

title: The Financial Sector is Liquid and Supports the Economy in Kosovo

detail.title: The Financial Sector is Liquid and Supports the Economy in Kosovo
detail.abstract: During the meetings held with representatives of the International Monetary Fund, we informed them about the latest developments and data of the financial system in Kosovo. The financial system in Kosovo has continued to be liquid and well capitalized, where double-digit growth has been recorded in all indicators being one of the important factors in the economic growth and development of the country.

AI.tldr: 科索沃金融系统保持流动性和资本充足，各项指标实现两位数增长，成为国家经济增长和发展的重要因素。
AI.research_question: 科索沃金融系统的发展状况及其对经济增长的影响
AI.motivation: 向国际货币基金组织通报科索沃金融系统的最新发展和数据，展示其稳健表现
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融发展与经济增长理论
AI.method: 数据分析和通报会议
AI.findings: 科索沃金融系统保持流动性和资本充足，各项指标实现两位数增长
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了金融系统稳健性对经济发展的促进作用
AI.practical_contributions: 为科索沃金融政策制定和国际合作提供参考依据

title: Wage Flexibility and Household Heterogeneity in a Small Open Economy
affiliations: University of Copenhagen

detail.title: Wage Flexibility and Household Heterogeneity in a Small Open Economy
detail.abstract: Structural reforms that increase labour market flexibility are conventionally believed to facilitate employment stability. These stability benefits depend on the responsiveness of employment to labour cost adjustments. In a standard New Keynesian model, this responsiveness depends on aggregate demand and the endogenous reaction of monetary policy, which is muted in a monetary union. I revisit this effect in a small open-economy HANK model, where demand is directly affected by changes in the real wage. I first simulate a temporary payroll tax cut and compare the responses for a Taylor rule versus a monetary union, showing that employment is responsive to labor cost reductions under both monetary regimes. I then simulate foreign interest rate and foreign demand shocks to assess welfare losses at varying levels of wage flexibility. I find that: (i) wage flexibility increases the responsiveness of employment in the face of adverse foreign shocks; (ii) in a monetary union, wage flexibility results in substantial relative welfare losses, especially for poorer households, driven by income and multiplier effects, while for a Taylor rule, welfare effects are smaller and co-determined by the monetary policy response; and (iii) a one-for-one increase in both price and wage flexibility has minimal welfare effects, whereas a decrease in flexibility yields relative gains for an interest rate shock and relative losses for a foreign demand shock under both regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文通过小开放经济HANK模型研究发现，在货币联盟中，工资灵活性虽然能提高就业对外部冲击的响应性，但会导致显著的福利损失，特别是对贫困家庭；而在泰勒规则下，福利影响较小且受货币政策响应共同决定。
AI.research_question: 工资灵活性在不同货币政策体制下如何影响就业稳定性和福利分配？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为增加劳动力市场灵活性的结构改革有助于就业稳定，但这种稳定效益取决于就业对劳动力成本调整的响应性，而该响应性在货币联盟中可能受到限制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新凯恩斯主义模型、小开放经济HANK模型（异质性代理人新凯恩斯模型）、泰勒规则与货币联盟的比较分析
AI.method: 通过模拟临时工资税削减、外国利率冲击和外国需求冲击，比较泰勒规则与货币联盟下就业响应和福利损失
AI.findings: 1) 工资灵活性提高就业对外部冲击的响应性；2) 在货币联盟中，工资灵活性导致显著福利损失，特别是对贫困家庭；3) 价格和工资灵活性同步增加对福利影响最小
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统关于劳动力市场灵活性的观点，揭示了在货币联盟中工资灵活性的福利成本，特别是对收入分配的负面影响
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于结构改革设计的重要启示，强调在货币联盟中需要配套措施来缓解工资灵活性对贫困家庭的负面影响

title:
3D Models & Rights Management 
A Report on Copyright and Other Rights Assessments for 3D Models in Europeana
affiliations: and University of Exeter - School of Law

detail.title:
3D Models & Rights Management 
A Report on Copyright and Other Rights Assessments for 3D Models in Europeana
detail.abstract:
This study was commissioned by Europeana to support the provision of 3D content to Europeana.eu in line with the Recommendation on a common European data space for cultural heritage. Among other goals, the Recommendation aims to enable innovative forms of creation, while opening up new ways of digitally engaging with and enjoying cultural content, and to support the creative industries. These goals complement the Directive (EU) 2019/790 on Copyright and Related Rights in the Digital Single Market to clarify the status of public domain works of visual art and improve legal certainty around the reuse of non-original digital surrogates and other reproduction media.

The aim of this study is to map the legal frameworks and rights management practices that apply to 3D models to establish whether the rights asserted in them are valid. The overall objective is to improve the application of accurate rights statements to the 3D models contributed to Europeana.eu and the common European data space for cultural heritage (hereafter the data space) so they may be accessed, shared and reused. The findings are as follows:

  • At the time of this study, Europeana.eu publishes 4,646 3D models of cultural heritage objects and sites. While the underlying works are overwhelmingly in the public domain, 93% (or 4,366) of their 3D digitisation are subject to new copyright claims. Only 6.7% (or 311) are marked as public domain.
  • Approximately 75% of these copyright assertions are likely not warranted. This is because it is unlikely that a new copyright arises in 3D models that aim to accurately reproduce a cultural heritage object or site.
  • For a new copyright to arise: (1) there must be scope for creative choices to be made during the model’s production; (2) creative choices must in fact be taken; and (3) those creative choices must result in the model being the author’s own intellectual creation. The 3D model must be imprinted with the technician’s personal touch such that it is a new original expression, rather than a faithful reproduction of the source object.
  • Scope for creative decisions can arise during pre-production (e.g., when selecting items for digitisation, processing software, and equipment), production (e.g., with the camera or scanner set-up, positioning the objects, lighting, and capture settings) and post-production stages (e.g., selecting the images for processing, modifying mesh, and applying editing settings or processes). When these processes are predetermined by a specific goal or set by narrow technical or functional rules, a 3D model will be characterised by its technical function and therefore be non-original.
  • Even when they require significant time, expertise, and investment, non-original 3D models do not receive copyright protection. This exposes a certain irony for 3D heritage projects: the more someone invests in making a model accurate, the less likely it is to become the author’s own intellectual creation. By contrast, the more “original” the model, the less useful it becomes for study and other purposes that require reliable data and accuracy.
  • Against this backdrop, this study found that data providers are either misinterpreting copyright law or failing to disclose what makes a model original in the metadata, paradata, or other descriptions, which raises reliability and verifiability issues.
  • Other rights or conditions can affect a 3D model and might include related rights, property and cultural heritage laws, cultural rights and ethical considerations, and contractual or database rights. If arising, these rights also are not accurately reflected in the rights statements applied to 3D models on Europeana.eu.
  • Europeana does not currently have protocols to support accurate copyright assessments, such as using the Europeana Data Model (EDM) fields to indicate a model’s scientific accuracy or creative interpretations or by setting standards in the Europeana Licensing Framework (ELF) on metadata or paradata descriptions to disclose any original elements therein.
  • Europeana can help to build trust among data providers by supporting more accurate rights assessments while encouraging users to credit and provide attribution to projects. The EDM and ELF should be operationalised to enable the disclosure of information on what elements, if any, are protected in a model to also enable their study and use for scientific purposes, as well as attribution.
  • The recommendations made by this report to support the application of more accurate rights statements to 3D models contributed to Europeana.eu and the data space can be extended to all data space participants.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了欧洲数字文化遗产平台Europeana上3D模型的版权问题，发现93%的3D数字化模型被错误地主张版权保护，而实际上约75%的版权主张可能不成立，因为精确复制的3D模型缺乏原创性。研究提出了改进权利声明的建议。
AI.research_question: 3D文化遗产模型的版权主张是否有效？如何改进Europeana平台上3D模型的版权声明准确性？
AI.motivation: 支持欧洲文化遗产数据空间建设，促进3D内容的合法共享和重用，同时澄清公共领域视觉艺术品数字化副本的版权状态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧盟版权法框架，特别是原创性要求（作者自己的智力创造）、公共领域作品数字化、非原创数字替代品的法律地位。
AI.method: 法律框架分析、权利管理实践映射、Europeana平台上4,646个3D模型的版权声明统计分析。
AI.findings: 93%的3D模型被错误主张版权；75%的版权主张可能无效；精确复制的3D模型缺乏原创性；数据提供者误解版权法或未披露原创元素。
AI.theory_contributions: 明确了3D文化遗产模型获得版权保护的三项条件：创作选择空间、实际选择行为、形成作者个人印记；揭示了准确性与原创性之间的张力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为Europeana提供了改进权利评估协议的建议；建议利用EDM和ELF框架披露模型原创元素；支持更准确的权利声明应用。

title: The Banking Sector is able to Withstand Possible Negative Shocks

detail.title: The Banking Sector is able to Withstand Possible Negative Shocks
detail.abstract: Both throughout the world and in Kosovo, the last few years have been quite challenging and characterized by high uncertainty, for the financial system and for the country's economy. As a result of the adequate regulatory framework as well as high supervisory standards, the pandemic situation found the banking sector in Kosovo with high levels of capital and liquidity as well as very good quality of assets. Also, the prudent measures undertaken by the CBK in cooperation with the financial institutions operating in Kosovo have been shown to be very effective in maintaining financial stability and minimizing the consequences for the country's economy in general. This careful and proactive approach has made the banking sector go through this rather difficult period without suffering serious consequences, and today we have a banking sector that has in no way become a burden to the state, on the contrary, it is playing a very important role in lending to the economy and is serving as one of the main pillars of the stability and development of the country's economy.

AI.tldr: 科索沃银行业在疫情期间通过充足的资本和流动性、良好的资产质量以及审慎的监管措施，成功维持了金融稳定，并成为国家经济稳定和发展的重要支柱。
AI.research_question: 科索沃银行业如何在疫情期间保持金融稳定并支持经济发展？
AI.motivation: 全球和科索沃近年面临高度不确定性的挑战，需要研究银行业在危机中的表现和应对策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融稳定理论、银行业监管框架、危机管理理论
AI.method: 基于科索沃中央银行的监管数据和政策措施分析
AI.findings: 科索沃银行业凭借充足的资本流动性、良好资产质量和审慎监管措施，成功度过疫情危机，未成为国家负担，反而成为经济贷款和稳定的重要支柱。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了在充分监管框架下，银行业可以在危机中保持稳定并支持经济发展的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为其他发展中国家在危机时期维护金融稳定提供了可借鉴的监管经验和政策实践。

title: Macroprudential Policy, Monetary Policy and Non-bank Financial Intermediation
affiliations: European Central Bank (ECB), Bank of England, European Central Bank (ECB), European Central Bank, European Central Bank (ECB) and European Central Bank (ECB)

detail.title: Macroprudential Policy, Monetary Policy and Non-bank Financial Intermediation

publicationDetails.journalName: ECB: Working Paper Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: This paper examines the interplay between macroprudential policy, monetary policy and the non-bank financial intermediation (NBFI) sector, drawing on recent research and zooming in particularly on evidence from the euro area2. It documents the growth in the NBFI sector over the past two decades and its particular role in financing the real economy, assesses systemic risks that can emanate from the sector, considers how it interacts with monetary policy, and discusses the implications for macroprudential regulation. Firms are increasingly turning to capital markets for debt financing, with the NBFI sector thereby increasing its provision of credit to the real economy relative to banks. At the same time, the growth of market-based finance has been accompanied by increased liquidity and credit risk in the NBFI sector, together with pockets of high leverage. Monetary policy has also intersected with these dynamics. Recent episodes have shown that vulnerabilities in the NBFI sector can amplify market dynamics and create systemic risk in a highly interconnected financial system. Against this backdrop, the resilience of the NBFI sector should be strengthened, including from a macroprudential perspective, to support financial stability and the smooth transmission of monetary policy. Several open issues and challenges remain for future research and policy making.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了宏观审慎政策、货币政策与非银行金融中介（NBFI）部门之间的相互作用，重点关注欧元区证据。论文记录了NBFI部门的增长、系统性风险、与货币政策的互动，并讨论了宏观审慎监管的影响。
AI.research_question: 宏观审慎政策、货币政策与非银行金融中介部门之间如何相互作用？这些互动对金融稳定和货币政策传导有何影响？
AI.motivation: 过去二十年来NBFI部门快速增长，企业越来越多地通过资本市场进行债务融资，NBFI部门相对于银行向实体经济提供更多信贷。同时，基于市场的金融增长伴随着NBFI部门流动性风险、信用风险增加和高杠杆问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宏观审慎政策理论、货币政策传导机制、系统性风险理论、金融中介理论
AI.method: 基于现有研究的文献综述，特别关注欧元区的实证证据
AI.findings: NBFI部门的脆弱性可能放大市场动态，在高度互联的金融系统中创造系统性风险。NBFI部门与货币政策存在显著互动关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对宏观审慎政策、货币政策与NBFI部门相互作用机制的理解，为系统性风险管理理论提供新视角
AI.practical_contributions: 建议从宏观审慎角度加强NBFI部门的韧性，以支持金融稳定和货币政策顺畅传导，为政策制定提供参考

title: Clean Money, High Costs?
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Clean Money, High Costs?

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: International Finance Discussion Papers (Topic)

detail.abstract: A cornerstone of the law-and-finance literature is that stronger institutions reduce financial intermediation costs. Using global data on cross-border payment costs, I show this relationship can reverse in heavily regulated sectors. Anti-money laundering risks have larger cost effects in advanced economies with strong enforcement than in developing countries with weak enforcement, despite the former having lower underlying risks. This counterintuitive pattern reflects strong institutions operating through two channels: Directly reducing costs through risk mitigation and forcing risk-based pricing that eliminates cross-subsidization. The net results demonstrate that traditional studies can miss heterogeneity by not controlling for risk levels: Strong institutions benefit low-risk jurisdictions but force high-risk ones to pay higher costs for their risk profiles. Policy implications favor improving enforcement and lowering risks rather than treating these as substitutes. The findings have implications for emerging payment rails, such as regulated payment stablecoins, which face similar AML requirements.

AI.tldr: 传统研究认为强制度降低金融中介成本，但本文发现在严格监管领域，强制度反而可能增加成本。反洗钱风险在制度先进的发达经济体比制度薄弱的发展中国家成本效应更大，尽管前者实际风险更低。这反映了强制度通过风险缓解和风险定价两个渠道运作。
AI.research_question: 强制度是否总是降低金融中介成本？在严格监管领域，制度强度与成本的关系是否会逆转？
AI.motivation: 传统法律与金融文献认为强制度降低金融中介成本，但这一结论可能忽略了监管领域的异质性，特别是在反洗钱等严格监管领域。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度理论、风险定价理论、法律与金融文献、反洗钱监管框架
AI.method: 使用全球跨境支付成本数据进行分析，比较不同制度强度国家的成本效应
AI.findings: 反洗钱风险在制度先进的发达经济体成本效应更大，尽管其实际风险更低；强制度通过风险缓解和风险定价两个渠道运作；传统研究因未控制风险水平而忽略了异质性
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统法律与金融文献的简单结论，揭示了制度强度与成本关系的复杂性；提出了强制度的双重作用机制
AI.practical_contributions: 政策启示：应同时改善执法和降低风险，而非将其视为替代品；对新兴支付轨道（如受监管的稳定币）具有重要启示

title: Core Inflation in the Advanced Economies: A Regional Perspective
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Core Inflation in the Advanced Economies: A Regional Perspective

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: International Finance Discussion Papers (Topic)

detail.abstract: We explore differences in the dynamics of core inflation between Europe and North America using a Bayesian time series filter that decomposes the level of core inflation in the major advanced economies into regional, global, and country-specific components. We find a prominent role for both regional and global factors. Historically, the two regional components have at times diverged. Using reduced-form regressions, we examine the economic drivers behind the changes in our estimated global and regional components of U.S. core inflation, focusing on the post-pandemic inflation surge and subsequent pullback. The global component is associated with global supply frictions and past energy shocks. The North American regional component is associated with labor market tightness in the region.

AI.tldr: 本文使用贝叶斯时间序列滤波方法分析欧美核心通胀动态差异，发现区域和全球因素均起重要作用。全球因素与供应链摩擦和能源冲击相关，北美区域因素与劳动力市场紧张度相关。
AI.research_question: 欧洲和北美核心通胀动态存在哪些差异？全球和区域因素如何影响这些差异？
AI.motivation: 理解不同地区核心通胀动态的差异及其驱动因素，特别是疫情后通胀激增和回落的原因。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于贝叶斯时间序列滤波理论，将核心通胀分解为区域、全球和国家特定成分。
AI.method: 使用贝叶斯时间序列滤波方法分解核心通胀，并通过简化形式回归分析经济驱动因素。
AI.findings: 区域和全球因素在核心通胀动态中均起重要作用；历史上两个区域成分有时出现分歧；全球成分与全球供应摩擦和能源冲击相关；北美区域成分与劳动力市场紧张度相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了将核心通胀分解为区域、全球和国家特定成分的分析框架，深化了对通胀动态跨区域差异的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了识别通胀驱动因素的工具，有助于更精准地制定货币政策应对不同来源的通胀压力。

title: De-Dollarization? Diversification? Exploring Central Bank Gold Purchases and the Dollar's Role in International Reserves
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: De-Dollarization? Diversification? Exploring Central Bank Gold Purchases and the Dollar's Role in International Reserves

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: International Finance Discussion Papers (Topic)

detail.abstract: I examine how governments have managed their holdings of gold and dollar reserves in recent decades, a period when gold’s share of aggregate international reserves rose and the dollar’s share fell. Using data on central banks’ reserve currency composition and official sector purchases of U.S. assets, I argue that gold reserve accumulation is generally not associated with de-dollarization of international reserves at the country level, except in a few prominent cases. Instead, gold purchases are more consistent with most countries pursuing a modest diversification of international reserves that does not solely target a reduced dollar share. My evidence suggests that this characterization also applies to gold reserve accumulation in 2022 and 2023. Finally, I show that, while gold’s importance as a store of value for the official sector has grown since 2000, its use as a unit of account and a medium of exchange remains limited.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了政府如何管理黄金和美元储备，发现在大多数情况下黄金储备积累与去美元化无关，而是国际储备的适度多元化策略。
AI.research_question: 政府如何管理黄金和美元储备？黄金储备积累是否与去美元化相关？
AI.motivation: 近年来黄金在国际储备中的份额上升而美元份额下降，需要理解这种变化背后的驱动因素和政策意图。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际储备管理理论、货币多元化策略、黄金作为价值储存手段的理论
AI.method: 使用央行储备货币构成数据和官方部门购买美国资产的数据进行分析
AI.findings: 1. 黄金储备积累通常与国家层面的去美元化无关，只有少数例外情况；2. 黄金购买更符合大多数国家追求适度多元化的策略；3. 2022-2023年的黄金储备积累也符合这一特征；4. 黄金作为价值储存手段的重要性自2000年以来增长，但作为记账单位和交换媒介的使用仍然有限
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了黄金储备积累与去美元化之间的关系，提出了适度多元化的新解释框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于国际储备管理策略的实证证据，有助于理解各国央行的实际政策意图

title: Tax Reform, Subsidies, and Labor Supply
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF), ,  and International Monetary Fund (IMF)

detail.title: Tax Reform, Subsidies, and Labor Supply

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Despite recent progress, Türkiye’s low labor force participation (LFP) rate is macrocritical and stands out internationally. This paper examines two channels through which fiscal policy can affect LFP. First, we estimate the impact of Türkiye’s 2022 Minimum Living Allowance reform, which removed tax disadvantages faced by secondary earners. Second, we simulate the impact of conditional subsidies on Türkiye’s LFP. The analysis was based on four empirical models estimated for Türkiye using labor force survey micro data. The results confirmed that: (i) Turkish secondary earners increased their labor supply by more than primary earners following the removal of tax disadvantages in the 2022 reform; (ii) conditional childcare subsidies lead to a large increase in LFP at relatively low fiscal costs; (iii) conditional subsidies can achieve better labor market outcomes and further reduce fiscal costs compared to direct transfers.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了土耳其低劳动力参与率的两个财政政策影响渠道：2022年最低生活津贴改革消除第二收入者税收劣势的影响，以及有条件补贴对劳动力参与的影响。研究发现第二收入者对税收激励更敏感，有条件儿童保育补贴能以较低财政成本显著提高劳动力参与率。
AI.research_question: 财政政策如何通过消除第二收入者税收劣势和提供有条件补贴来影响土耳其的劳动力参与率？
AI.motivation: 土耳其的低劳动力参与率在国际上表现突出，对宏观经济具有关键影响，需要研究有效的财政政策干预措施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动力供给理论，特别是第二收入者对税收激励的响应机制，以及有条件补贴对劳动力参与的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用土耳其劳动力调查微观数据，估计了四个经验模型来分析2022年改革的影响和模拟有条件补贴的效果。
AI.findings: 1) 2022年改革后，土耳其第二收入者的劳动力供给增加幅度大于主要收入者；2) 有条件儿童保育补贴能以相对较低的财政成本大幅提高劳动力参与率；3) 与直接转移支付相比，有条件补贴能实现更好的劳动力市场结果并进一步降低财政成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对第二收入者税收激励敏感性的理解，为发展中国家劳动力市场政策设计提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为土耳其和其他类似国家提供了有效的财政政策工具建议，特别是强调有条件补贴相对于直接转移支付的优势。

title: Does Financial Stress Affect Commodity Futures Traders’ Positions?
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System,  and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Does Financial Stress Affect Commodity Futures Traders’ Positions?

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: Financial stress can impact trading behavior in the U.S. commodity futures markets. To clarify the impact, we study absolute changes and relative exposure dynamics in traders' positions during two recent crises: the 2008 Global Financial Crisis (GFC) and the COVID-19 pandemic. The nature of these two crises are very distinct, and we find that traders behaved quite differently. The commodity market collapse during the 2008 GFC followed the classic pattern of a speculative bubble; speculators, including financial institutions and money managers, rushed to close their long positions in commodity futures while commodity producers or hedgers actively facilitated these trades. Consequently, the risk in commodity futures flowed from speculators back to producers. In sharp contrast, no evidence is found to support this type of risk flow during the COVID-19 crisis. Stress in the financial system was relatively mild compared with the 2008 GFC, and the commodity market experienced a strong rally early in the crisis. Both speculators and hedgers traded in an orderly fashion. In terms of traders' relative exposures, we find that the impact from financial stress was immaterial. We also find that speculators generally reacted to changing financial conditions more strongly than hedgers, during the period.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了2008年全球金融危机和COVID-19疫情期间美国商品期货市场中交易者的行为差异。研究发现，在2008年危机中，投机者大量平仓多头头寸，风险从投机者流向生产者；而在COVID-19危机中，未发现类似风险流动，交易行为更为有序。
AI.research_question: 金融压力如何影响美国商品期货市场中交易者的头寸变化和相对风险敞口动态？
AI.motivation: 理解在不同性质的金融危机中，交易者行为的差异以及风险在不同类型交易者之间的流动模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于投机泡沫理论和风险转移理论，分析不同类型交易者（投机者与对冲者）在危机期间的行为模式。
AI.method: 比较分析法，研究2008年全球金融危机和COVID-19疫情期间交易者头寸的绝对变化和相对风险敞口动态。
AI.findings: 1. 2008年危机中投机者大量平仓多头头寸，风险从投机者流向生产者；2. COVID-19危机中未发现类似风险流动；3. 投机者对金融条件变化的反应比对冲者更强烈；4. 金融压力对交易者相对风险敞口的影响不显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了不同类型金融危机中交易者行为的系统性差异，丰富了危机期间市场微观结构理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构和市场参与者在不同危机情境下的风险管理提供实证依据，有助于制定更有针对性的风险防控策略。

title: Do Banks Price Flood Risk in Mortgage Origination: Evidence from a Natural Experiment in New Orleans
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Do Banks Price Flood Risk in Mortgage Origination: Evidence from a Natural Experiment in New Orleans

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: This paper uses a large-scale redrawing of flood zone maps for the City of New Orleans in 2016 to identify how banks respond to changes in perceived flood risk in residential mortgage origination. Using geo-coding, we separate loan-level data on mortgage originations into treatment versus control groups based on how individual properties were affected by the map changes. We find banks charged interest rates that were roughly 6 basis points higher for mortgages on treated properties that were removed from the special floods zones as a result of the map changes. In addition, lower loan-to-value ratios for mortgages on these properties suggest that banks also required higher downpayments. Both effects are temporary, lasting under two years. Further analysis using flood insurance claims data following a major flooding event in 2017 suggests the temporary nature of these effects may reflect learning by banks about the true extent of flood risk and insurance take-up following the map changes.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2016年新奥尔良市洪水区地图重绘，研究银行如何应对住宅抵押贷款中感知洪水风险的变化。研究发现，对于被移出特殊洪水区的房产，银行收取的利率高出约6个基点，并要求更高的首付比例，但这些影响是暂时的（持续不到两年）。
AI.research_question: 银行如何应对洪水区地图变化导致的感知洪水风险变化？
AI.motivation: 了解金融机构在面对自然灾害风险信息更新时的决策行为，特别是洪水风险认知变化对抵押贷款定价和条件的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息不对称理论和银行风险管理理论，探讨银行如何根据更新的洪水风险信息调整贷款决策。
AI.method: 使用地理编码方法，将抵押贷款数据根据房产是否受地图变化影响分为处理组和对照组，比较两组在利率和贷款价值比上的差异。

title: Optimal Policy for Financial Market Tokenization
affiliations: IMF and International Monetary Fund

detail.title: Optimal Policy for Financial Market Tokenization

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Competing broker initiatives to “tokenize” financial assets—i.e., represent them on programmable platforms—promise efficiency gains but raise concerns about market fragmentation. Policymakers in several countries are considering supporting such platforms or mandating their interoperability. We provide the first formal framework for analyzing optimal policy in this context. Brokers with heterogeneous market power compete to attract investors and execute their trades intra-broker or on a legacy platform. Coalitions of brokers can invest in creating a tokenized market with faster, cheaper inter-broker settlement. Partial coalitions divert trades away from excluded competitors, leading to equilibrium coalition structures that can feature excessive investment or insufficient tokenization. Neither public-private cost-sharing nor interoperability mandates are sufficient to achieve the social optimum when used alone, but their combination is. These results withstand incorporating an open-access ledger (e.g., a public blockchain).

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个分析金融资产代币化平台最优政策的正式框架，研究了经纪商联盟创建代币化市场的竞争动态，发现单独使用公私成本分担或互操作性授权都无法实现社会最优，但两者结合可以。

detail.abstract: Consensus mechanisms underpin the effective operation of blockchains by ensuring a single consistent and honest ledger. The design and implementation of these consensus mechanisms can improve or impede the ability of regulatory and supervisory authorities to achieve their objectives and mandates. This paper provides an update to the Fintech Note Blockchain Consensus Mechanisms: A Primer for Supervisors (2022) by reviewing the growth of existing consensus mechanisms, exploring new consensus mechanisms, and the development of layer 2 protocols. It is a non-technical and accessible note to provide supervisors a broad understanding of the technology within their remits.

title: Ex Ante Heterogeneity, Separations, and Labor Market Dynamics
affiliations: and Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg

detail.title: Ex Ante Heterogeneity, Separations, and Labor Market Dynamics

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Our paper documents the importance of ex ante worker heterogeneity for labor market dynamics and for the composition of the unemployment pool over the business cycle. In recessions, the unemployment pool shifts toward workers with higher wages in their previous jobs. Based on administrative data for Germany and two-way worker and firm wage fixed effects, we show that this shift is mainly connected to worker heterogeneity, not to firm heterogeneity. We calibrate a search and matching model with ex ante worker heterogeneity to the estimated relative residual wage dispersion across worker fixed-effect groups. We show that a lower idiosyncratic match-specific shock dispersion for high-wage workers is key for the larger relative fluctuations of their separation rate as well as for the positive comovement between prior wages and fixed effects of unemployed workers with aggregate unemployment. We argue that firm-based explanations, such as cyclical financial frictions, are unlikely to be key drivers for the documented empirical patterns.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，在经济衰退期间，失业群体中高工资工人的比例增加，这主要是由工人异质性而非企业异质性驱动的。通过校准搜索匹配模型，发现高工资工人的匹配特定冲击离散度较低是导致其离职率波动更大的关键因素。
AI.research_question: 工人异质性对劳动力市场动态和失业群体构成在商业周期中的重要性是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解经济衰退期间失业群体构成的变化及其驱动因素，特别是工人异质性和企业异质性的相对重要性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 搜索匹配模型，包含事前工人异质性，考虑工人固定效应和匹配特定冲击。
AI.method: 使用德国行政数据和双向工人-企业工资固定效应模型进行实证分析，并校准搜索匹配模型。
AI.findings: 经济衰退时失业群体向高工资工人倾斜；这种变化主要源于工人异质性；高工资工人的匹配特定冲击离散度较低导致其离职率波动更大。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于工人异质性的解释框架，挑战了基于企业异质性的传统解释（如周期性金融摩擦）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为劳动力市场政策制定提供了新视角，强调需要针对不同工人群体的特定需求设计政策。

title: Improving Rationality by Increasing Attention
affiliations: , University of Zurich, University of Zurich - Department of Economics, University of Zurich, University of Zurich - Department of Economics, , , University of Zurich, University of Zurich and University of Zurich - Department of Economics

detail.title: Improving Rationality by Increasing Attention

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Models of limited attention have the potential to become a new unifying paradigm that could replace the rational choice approach. In this paper, we test the limited attention hypothesis by enhancing attention using pharmacological substances. A total of 160 subjects participated in our randomized, placebo-controlled, and double-blind experimental study. We find that enhancing attention through boosting the noradrenergic system with reboxetine improves the quality of choice as captured by multiple different measures of rationality. Eye-tracking suggests that boosting noradrenaline promotes more rational choice by efficiently directing attention to more valuable options. Other attention-enhancing drugs (methylphenidate, which boosts the dopaminergic system, and nicotine, which boosts the cholinergic system) improve rationality to a lesser extent. Aside from testing the limited attention hypothesis directly, our results have implications for welfare economics, policy-design, and public health.

AI.tldr: 通过药物增强注意力可以提高决策理性，特别是使用瑞波西汀增强去甲肾上腺素系统效果最显著，其他注意力增强药物效果较弱
AI.research_question: 增强注意力是否能提高决策理性？不同神经递质系统在注意力调节中的作用有何差异？
AI.motivation: 有限注意力模型有潜力成为替代理性选择方法的新统一范式，需要直接验证有限注意力假说
AI.theoretical_framework: 有限注意力理论、神经经济学、理性选择理论
AI.method: 随机、安慰剂对照、双盲实验设计，160名受试者，使用眼动追踪技术，测试三种注意力增强药物（瑞波西汀、哌甲酯、尼古丁）
AI.findings: 瑞波西汀（增强去甲肾上腺素系统）显著提高决策理性，眼动追踪显示其通过有效引导注意力到更有价值选项来实现；其他药物效果较弱
AI.theory_contributions: 直接验证有限注意力假说，揭示不同神经递质系统在注意力调节中的差异化作用
AI.practical_contributions: 对福利经济学、政策设计和公共健康具有重要启示

title: Foreign Direct Investment Legislation and Economic Growth in Western Balkan Countries: A Panel Analysis
affiliations: AAB College, ,  and Vytautas Magnus University

detail.title: Foreign Direct Investment Legislation and Economic Growth in Western Balkan Countries: A Panel Analysis
detail.abstract: Foreign direct investment (FDI) legislation plays a crucial role in fetching foreign investments. The objective of this study is to measure the impact of FDI on the Western Balkans countries (WBCs) and interpret the FDI law in the said countries. A panel data was obtained from the World Bank Indicators in order to conduct an empirical investigation. The sample is spread over twenty-eight years from 1995 to 2022. For econometric analysis, the study uses pooled ordinary least square (OLS), fixed effect (FE), random effect (RE), and Hausman test. The study also uses the Breuch and Pagan Lagrangian Multiplier test for Random Effect, the test for parameter constancy, the modified Wald test for groupwise heteroskedasticity, the Wooldridge test for autocorrelation, the test for serial correlation in residuals, and a test for normality. After a detailed analysis, the study concludes that FDI has a positive impact on the economic growth of WBCs. The study suggests that enforcing the rule of law on FDI will reduce the corruption index and create a favourable environment for WBCs to attract foreign investment.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过实证分析发现，外国直接投资对西巴尔干国家的经济增长有积极影响，建议加强FDI法治以减少腐败并创造有利的投资环境。

title: The Spatial Dynamics of the Energy Transition Process: A Pilot Analysis on the Effects of Cobalt Mining on Agriculture, Migration and Conflict

detail.title: The Spatial Dynamics of the Energy Transition Process: A Pilot Analysis on the Effects of Cobalt Mining on Agriculture, Migration and Conflict
detail.abstract: The global transition to a low-carbon economy has exponentially increased the demand for critical raw materials, with cobalt being central to battery production. The Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) holds the majority of the world’s cobalt reserves, placing it at the epicenter of this resource boom. While previous research has highlighted the adverse effects of cobalt mining on child labor and education, its broader socio-economic and political impacts remain underexplored. This pilot study provides a preliminary analysis of the spatial effects of cobalt deposits on key development indicators in the DRC between 2005 and 20010. Employing a spatial regression model, I analyze the impact on agricultural output, conflict incidence, and migrant characteristics. My preliminary findings reveal complex and spatially heterogeneous effects. I observe a significant reduction in agricultural production of 9% within a 50km radius of cobalt deposits, contrasted by a 2% increase in an annulus between 50km and 200km. In terms of security, I find a localized pacifying effect, with an 11% reduction in conflict incidence within 20km of the nearest deposit, and no discernible effect at greater distances. Finally, analysis of migrant data suggests that mining areas act as a magnet for a more educated workforce; migrants in cobalt communities achieve higher levels of education (8.7 years) and wealth (4.2 index score) compared to their counterparts in non-mining areas (7.9 years and 3.8 index score, respectively). These initial findings underscore the multifaceted impacts of the CRM boom, highlighting the failure of the traditional “resource curse” paradigm and the urgent need for a new, CRM-tailored analytical framework.

AI.tldr: 该研究初步分析了刚果民主共和国钴矿开采对农业产出、冲突发生率和移民特征的空间影响，发现复杂且异质性的效应：钴矿附近50公里内农业产量下降9%，但50-200公里环带内增加2%；20公里内冲突发生率降低11%；钴矿地区吸引了更高教育水平和财富的移民。
AI.research_question: 钴矿开采对刚果民主共和国关键发展指标的空间影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 全球向低碳经济转型导致对钴等关键原材料需求激增，刚果民主共和国拥有全球大部分钴储量，但钴矿开采的广泛社会经济和政治影响研究不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 挑战传统'资源诅咒'理论，提出需要针对关键原材料制定新的分析框架。
AI.method: 采用空间回归模型，分析2005-2010年间钴矿对农业产出、冲突发生率和移民特征的影响。
AI.findings: 钴矿开采产生复杂空间效应：50公里内农业产量下降9%，50-200公里环带内增加2%；20公里内冲突发生率降低11%；钴矿地区移民教育水平更高（8.7年vs 7.9年），财富指数更高（4.2 vs 3.8）。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战传统资源诅咒理论，强调需要针对关键原材料制定新的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供钴矿开采空间影响的实证证据，有助于制定更精准的区域发展政策。

title: Attention-Dependent Monetary Transmission to Household Beliefs
affiliations: , Yonsei University and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Attention-Dependent Monetary Transmission to Household Beliefs

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: When do households listen to the Fed? We show the answer lies in a simple but powerful force: household attention to macroeconomic conditions. We develop a model where attention acts as a crucial gatekeeper for the pass-through of policy news to beliefs, and confirm its predictions using household survey data. We find that belief revisions to monetary policy surprises are concentrated among attentive individuals—particularly those with high financial stakes—and this effect strengthens dramatically during uncertain times. This implies the expectations channel is most potent when it matters most, suggesting policymakers should account for the time-varying and heterogeneous nature of public attention.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，家庭对美联储政策的反应取决于其对宏观经济状况的关注度。关注度是政策新闻影响家庭信念的关键调节因素，在不确定时期这种效应尤为显著。
