title: Non-homothetic Demand Shifts and Inflation Inequality

detail.title: Non-homothetic Demand Shifts and Inflation Inequality

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: This paper shows that adverse macroeconomic shocks systematically increase inflation for low-income households relative to high-income households. I document two key facts: (i) during every U.S. recession since 1959, aggregate spending shifts toward products disproportionately purchased by low-income households (necessities); and (ii) relative prices of necessities rise during recessions. These patterns can be explained by a model with non-homothetic demand and a concave production possibility frontier: shocks that reduce expenditure induce households to reallocate spending from luxuries to necessities, raising their relative prices. I empirically show that this mechanism operates for both demand and supply shocks, using monetary policy and oil price news shocks. Incorporating this mechanism into a quantitative model reproduces most of the variation in necessity prices and shares from 1961 to 2024. The model shows that the fall in expenditure due to a recessionary shock similar to the Great Recession leads inflation to increase by more than 1.5 percentage points for low-income households relative to high-income households. The results suggest that low-income households are hit twice by adverse shocks: once by the shock itself and again as their price index increases relative to that of other households.

AI.tldr: 本文发现宏观经济冲击会系统性增加低收入家庭相对于高收入家庭的通胀水平。研究表明，衰退期间支出向必需品转移，必需品相对价格上涨，这种机制通过非位似需求和凹性生产可能性边界解释，导致低收入家庭在冲击中遭受双重打击。
AI.research_question: 宏观经济冲击如何影响不同收入群体的通胀差异？
AI.motivation: 理解经济衰退对不同收入群体通胀影响的异质性，揭示低收入家庭在冲击中面临的额外负担。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非位似需求理论和凹性生产可能性边界模型
AI.method: 实证分析美国1959年以来历次衰退数据，使用货币政策和油价新闻冲击验证机制，构建定量模型进行模拟
AI.findings: 衰退期间支出向必需品转移，必需品相对价格上涨；类似大衰退的冲击使低收入家庭通胀比高收入家庭高1.5个百分点以上
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了宏观经济冲击通过支出再分配影响不同收入群体通胀差异的理论机制
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了低收入家庭在衰退中遭受双重打击的政策含义，为针对性政策设计提供依据

title: Monetary Policy and Bank Funding Costs: Patterns and Predictability in the Transmission of the Policy Rate to U.S. Banks’ Funding Costs
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and

detail.title: Monetary Policy and Bank Funding Costs: Patterns and Predictability in the Transmission of the Policy Rate to U.S. Banks’ Funding Costs

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: This paper shows that U.S. commercial banks' funding betas rise predictably with the length, magnitude, and direction of each monetary policy cycle: longer cycles and those with larger changes in the policy rate yield stronger pass-through in both tightening and loosening cycles, with modest asymmetry favoring slightly greater transmission during loosening cycles. Nondeposit liabilities consistently adjust more than deposits. Crucially, at the aggregate banking-system level and across banks grouped by size, this cycle-dependent relationship has remained remarkably stable over three decades, highlighting the durability and predictability of interest-rate transmission to banks' funding costs.

AI.tldr: 美国商业银行的资金成本对货币政策的敏感度随着政策周期的长度、幅度和方向而变化：周期越长、政策利率变化越大，传导效应越强，且在宽松周期中传导略强。非存款负债的调整幅度大于存款。这种周期依赖关系在30年间保持稳定，凸显了利率传导至银行资金成本的持久性和可预测性。
AI.research_question: 美国商业银行的资金成本对货币政策的敏感度如何随政策周期的特征而变化？
AI.motivation: 理解货币政策如何通过银行资金成本传导至实体经济，以及这种传导机制在不同政策周期中的变化规律。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币政策传导机制理论、银行资金成本理论、利率周期理论
AI.method: 基于30年美国商业银行数据的实证分析，考察不同货币政策周期特征对银行资金成本敏感度的影响
AI.findings: 资金成本敏感度随政策周期长度和幅度增加而上升；宽松周期传导略强于紧缩周期；非存款负债调整幅度大于存款；这种关系在30年间保持稳定
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了货币政策传导的周期依赖性特征，丰富了利率传导机制理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行制定货币政策、银行管理资金成本提供了实证依据，有助于预测政策效果

title: Is Short-Time Work a Climate-Adapted Legacy System? Evidence from Natural Disasters in France between 2015 and 2022
affiliations: , RMIT, Unédic - French Unemployment Insurance and Unédic - French Unemployment Insurance

detail.title: Is Short-Time Work a Climate-Adapted Legacy System? Evidence from Natural Disasters in France between 2015 and 2022
detail.abstract: Climate change is increasingly disrupting labour markets, notably through natural disasters; yet, little is known about how existing employment protection institutions absorb these shocks. We provide the first empirical evidence of short-time work (STW) as a climate-adapted legacy welfare institution, originally designed for economic stabilisation but now evolving to address climate risks. Using exhaustive French administrative data, we constructed a panel of 2.8 million municipality-month observations (2015-2022) and applied AI-categorisations of employer justifications to identify weather-related STW use. Municipalities hit by natural disasters show 3.2 times higher odds of weather-related STW activation, rising to 14.4 times for floods, with additional spillover effects (1.4 times higher non-weather STW usage). Annual costs are modest (€2-19 million) but escalate during major events. Applying an ecosocial policy lens, we demonstrate that STW is leveraged to absorb climate-induced labour market risks through drift and conversion mechanisms, illustrating how welfare institutions incrementally adapt to climate-induced disruptions.

AI.tldr: 本文首次实证证明短期工作计划(STW)作为气候适应的福利制度，能够吸收气候变化对劳动力市场的冲击。研究发现遭受自然灾害的法国城市使用天气相关STW的几率高出3.2倍，洪水灾害时更高达14.4倍，年度成本为200-1900万欧元。
AI.research_question: 现有的就业保护制度如何吸收气候变化对劳动力市场的冲击？短期工作计划(STW)是否能够作为气候适应的福利制度？
AI.motivation: 气候变化通过自然灾害日益扰乱劳动力市场，但人们对现有就业保护机构如何吸收这些冲击知之甚少。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生态社会政策视角，制度漂移和转换机制，福利制度适应理论
AI.method: 使用法国行政数据构建280万个城市-月度观测面板(2015-2022)，应用AI分类雇主理由识别天气相关STW使用
AI.findings: 遭受自然灾害的城市天气相关STW激活几率高出3.2倍，洪水灾害时达14.4倍；存在溢出效应(非天气STW使用高出1.4倍)；年度成本适中但重大事件期间上升
AI.theory_contributions: 首次实证证明STW作为气候适应福利制度的作用，展示福利制度通过漂移和转换机制逐步适应气候冲击
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了STW在气候风险管理中的实际应用证据，展示了现有福利制度在应对气候风险时的适应潜力

title: Foreign Direct Investments and Fiscal Stimulation in Ballkans: Evidence from Albania, Kosovo and Macedonia

detail.title: Foreign Direct Investments and Fiscal Stimulation in Ballkans: Evidence from Albania, Kosovo and Macedonia
detail.abstract: This paper analyzes the trends and factor determinations attracting foreign capital inflows into selected Balkan countries-Albania, Kosovo and Macedonia using a documented analysis. The study revealed that despite tax incentives and promotional activities undertaken by the governments to create investment environment, capital inflow in selected Balkan countries is still modest, reflecting a weak overall investment climate in the region. According the results of the study, reason for lower FDI in analyzed countries are several: regional political instability, absence of institutional quality and prospects of EU membership, size of their economy, threats from corruption and partial observance of regulation, was the significant investment impediment. According to the theoretical findings and empirical evidence, the paper subsequently suggests that fiscal stimulus are only marginally efficient in the absence of political stability, structural reforms, strategic development policies and EU integrations.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了巴尔干国家（阿尔巴尼亚、科索沃和马其顿）吸引外资的趋势和决定因素。研究发现，尽管政府提供了税收激励和投资促进活动，但该地区外资流入仍然有限，主要障碍包括政治不稳定、制度质量差、欧盟成员前景不明、经济规模小、腐败问题和监管执行不力。
AI.research_question: 影响巴尔干国家（阿尔巴尼亚、科索沃和马其顿）吸引外国直接投资的主要因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 了解为什么这些巴尔干国家尽管提供了税收激励和投资促进措施，但外国直接投资流入仍然有限，以识别阻碍外资流入的关键障碍。
AI.theoretical_framework: 外国直接投资理论，包括投资环境评估、制度质量理论、政治风险分析等。
AI.method: 文献分析法和实证证据分析。
AI.findings: 研究发现，税收激励措施在缺乏政治稳定、结构性改革、战略发展政策和欧盟一体化的情况下效果有限。主要投资障碍包括地区政治不稳定、制度质量差、欧盟成员前景不明、经济规模小、腐败问题和监管执行不力。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了外国直接投资理论在转型经济体中的应用，强调了制度因素和政治稳定性对投资环境的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴尔干国家政府提供了政策建议，指出仅靠财政刺激不足以吸引外资，需要同时改善政治稳定、推进结构性改革和欧盟一体化进程。

title: Forecasting House Prices and Rents: Combining Dynamic Factor Models with Machine Learning
affiliations: Poznan University of Economics and Business and University of Connecticut - School of Business

detail.title: Forecasting House Prices and Rents: Combining Dynamic Factor Models with Machine Learning

declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by the National Science Centre of Poland under Grant numbers 2017/27/B/HS4/01848 and 2021/43/B/HS4/01213.

detail.abstract: In this study, we investigate the performance of dynamic factor models and machine learning methods for forecasting house price and rent indexes in Poland between 2000-2023. In the research, we employed traditional econometric approaches with contemporary machine learning techniques under different forecast horizons. We implement autoregressive distributed lag (ARDL) models augmented with dynamic factor models for dimensionality reduction and LASSO regression for variable selection. The model specification incorporates macroeconomic variables (GDP, unemployment rate, construction costs, and mortgage rates) and dynamics of apartment prices. The research findings indicate that models incorporating cross-city price information substantially outperform those that are based solely on macroeconomic fundamentals. LASSO-based approaches exhibit superior predictive accuracy, particularly for shorter forecast horizons. Mean absolute prediction errors range from 4.5% for 4-quarter horizons to approximately 11.7% for 16-quarter horizons. The results underscore the significance of spatial co-movement in housing market dynamics and demonstrate the efficiency of machine learning methods in capturing housing market interdependencies.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较了动态因子模型和机器学习方法在预测波兰房价和租金指数（2000-2023）方面的表现，发现结合跨城市价格信息的LASSO方法在短期预测中表现最佳。
AI.research_question: 动态因子模型和机器学习方法在预测波兰房价和租金指数方面的相对表现如何？
AI.motivation: 传统计量经济学方法在预测住房市场时存在局限性，需要探索结合机器学习技术的新方法以提高预测准确性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态因子模型、ARDL模型、LASSO回归、住房市场空间联动理论
AI.method: 使用ARDL模型结合动态因子模型进行降维，采用LASSO回归进行变量选择，纳入宏观经济变量（GDP、失业率、建筑成本、抵押贷款利率）和公寓价格动态
AI.findings: 结合跨城市价格信息的模型显著优于仅基于宏观经济基本面的模型；LASSO方法在短期预测中表现最佳；4季度预测误差4.5%，16季度预测误差11.7%
AI.theory_contributions: 证实了住房市场空间联动的重要性，展示了机器学习方法在捕捉住房市场相互依赖关系方面的效率
AI.practical_contributions: 为房地产投资者和政策制定者提供了更准确的房价预测工具，特别是在短期预测方面

title: Move a Little Closer? Information Sharing and the Spatial Clustering of Bank Branches
affiliations: Xiamen University - School of Management, European Bank for Reconstruction and Development, University of Zurich - Department Finance, Maastricht University  and KU Leuven - Faculty of Business and Economics (FEB)

detail.title: Move a Little Closer? Information Sharing and the Spatial Clustering of Bank Branches

publicationDetails.journalName: European Bank for Reconstruction & Development Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We present a model of credit market competition to derive key hypotheses about how information sharing between banks influences the spatial clustering of their branches. We then test these hypotheses using data on 56,555 branches owned by 614 banks across 19 countries. We find that information sharing incentivizes banks to establish branches in localities that are new to them but that are already served by other banks. The resultant branch clustering is associated with reduced spatial credit rationing, as information sharing enables firms to access credit from more distant banks. These findings underscore how information sharing makes it more important for banks to move closer to each other rather than closer to their borrowers.

AI.tldr: 信息共享促使银行在已有其他银行服务的地区开设分行，导致分行聚集，从而减少空间信贷配给，使企业能从更远的银行获得信贷。
AI.research_question: 信息共享如何影响银行分行的空间分布？
AI.motivation: 理解银行分行空间分布的决定因素及其对信贷可获得性的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信贷市场竞争模型，分析信息共享对银行分行选址决策的影响。
AI.method: 使用19个国家614家银行的56,555家分行数据，实证检验信息共享对分行空间分布的影响。
AI.findings: 信息共享激励银行在已有其他银行服务的地区开设分行，导致分行聚集，减少空间信贷配给，使企业能从更远的银行获得信贷。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了信息共享影响银行分行空间分布的理论模型，揭示了信息共享如何改变银行竞争策略。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行分行选址决策提供指导，政策制定者可利用信息共享促进信贷可获得性。

title: Bank Lending is Continuing to Contribute to Economic Growth

detail.title: Bank Lending is Continuing to Contribute to Economic Growth
detail.abstract: The grant that is being donated by KFW will enable the further increase of the guarantee potential of this institution, making possible the increase of the number of beneficiaries from the guarantees issued by this institution. In other words, a larger number of individuals or businesses with difficulty accessing credit financing will be able to secure access to this source of financing on favorable terms. Bank lending continues to be a very important and sustainable source of private sector financing in Kosovo. The value of bank loans by September 2021 has reached 3.57 billion euros, marking a significant annual increase of 12.2%. However, despite the satisfactory trend of increasing bank lending, it is considered that the level of financial intermediation in Kosovo continues to be below the average of the countries in the region, which shows that, in relation to the size of the economy, there is further room for expansion of the lending activity.

AI.tldr: KFW赠款将提升科索沃担保机构的担保能力，帮助更多难以获得信贷融资的个人和企业获得优惠融资。尽管科索沃银行贷款在2021年9月达到35.7亿欧元，年增长12.2%，但金融中介水平仍低于地区平均水平，表明贷款活动仍有扩张空间。
AI.research_question: KFW赠款如何影响科索沃担保机构的担保能力以及信贷融资的可及性？
AI.motivation: 科索沃的金融中介水平低于地区平均水平，许多个人和企业难以获得信贷融资，需要通过担保机构提升融资可及性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融中介理论、信贷担保机制、普惠金融理论
AI.method: 数据分析（银行贷款统计数据）、案例研究（KFW赠款对担保机构的影响）
AI.findings: KFW赠款能显著提升担保机构的担保能力，帮助更多借款人获得融资；科索沃银行贷款虽有增长，但金融中介水平仍低于地区标准。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对担保机制在提升金融中介效率中作用的理解，为发展中国家金融体系研究提供新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供通过担保机制改善信贷可及性的实践方案，帮助金融机构优化信贷资源配置。

title: Flourishing Considerations for AI
affiliations: and Harvard University - Institute for Quantitative Social Science

detail.title: Flourishing Considerations for AI
detail.abstract: We put forward principled considerations concerning flourishing and AI that are oriented towards ensuring AI technologies are conducive to human flourishing, rather than impeding it. The considerations are intended to help guide discussions around the development of, and engagement with, AI technologies so as to orient them towards the promotion of individual and societal flourishing. Five sets of considerations around flourishing and AI are put forward concerning: (i) the output provided by large language models; (ii) the specific AI product design; (iii) our engagement with those products; and also the effects this is having on (iv) human knowledge; and on (v) the self-realization of the human person. While not exhaustive, we believe each of these considerations must be taken seriously if these technologies are to help promote, rather than impede, flourishing. We suggest that we should ultimately frame all of our thinking on AI technologies around flourishing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了关于人工智能与人类繁荣的五个原则性考量，旨在确保AI技术促进而非阻碍人类繁荣。这些考量涉及大语言模型输出、AI产品设计、人机交互、人类知识和自我实现等方面。
AI.research_question: 如何确保人工智能技术促进而非阻碍人类繁荣？
AI.motivation: 随着AI技术的快速发展，需要建立原则性框架来引导AI技术的发展方向，确保其服务于人类繁荣的目标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人类繁荣理论，强调AI技术应当促进个体和社会的全面发展。
AI.method: 提出五个原则性考量框架，包括理论分析和概念构建。
AI.findings: 确定了五个关键考量领域：大语言模型输出、AI产品设计、人机交互、人类知识和自我实现。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了AI与人类繁荣关系的理论框架，为AI伦理和发展提供了新的视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI开发者、政策制定者和用户提供了具体指导原则，帮助确保AI技术服务于人类繁荣目标。

title: Ring-Fencing Capital Allowances in Nigeria: A Policy Imperative for Targeted Economic Growth
affiliations: Federal Inland Revenue Service

detail.title: Ring-Fencing Capital Allowances in Nigeria: A Policy Imperative for Targeted Economic Growth

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There is no personal or financial relationship with the organization that may have or could be perceived to have influenced this study. This study was borne out of passion to enlighten the public on the topic.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This is not applicable to this study
declarations.funderStatement: No one funded the research. It was carried out by a personal fund.

detail.abstract: This paper provides a detailed examination of the "ring-fencing" principle as it applies to the taxation of capital allowances for businesses operating in priority sectors in Nigeria. Drawing on the provisions of the Nigeria Tax Act, 2025, this analysis explains how this core tax policy ensures that economic development incentives are precisely targeted. The principle prevents companies from using tax relief from subsidized activities to reduce their overall tax burden on unrelated, non-priority business ventures. Through a clear explanation of the tax treatment, illustrative examples, and an exploration of the policy's objectives, this paper demonstrates that ring-fencing is a powerful tool for shaping a country's economic landscape, fostering sustainable development, and preventing tax leakage.

AI.tldr: 本文详细分析了尼日利亚优先行业资本补贴税收中的'围栏原则'，解释了该原则如何确保经济发展激励措施精准定向，防止企业利用补贴活动的税收减免来降低非优先业务的整体税负。
AI.research_question: 围栏原则如何影响尼日利亚优先行业企业的资本补贴税收处理？
AI.motivation: 分析围栏原则在尼日利亚税收政策中的应用，确保经济发展激励措施的有效性和针对性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于尼日利亚2025年税法规定，探讨围栏原则的理论基础和政策目标。
AI.method: 通过税法条款分析、税收处理解释和案例说明来研究围栏原则的应用。
AI.findings: 围栏原则是塑造国家经济格局、促进可持续发展和防止税收流失的有力工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对围栏原则在税收政策中作用的理论理解，特别是在发展中国家经济激励政策中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了清晰的税收处理指导，帮助政策制定者更有效地设计和实施经济发展激励措施。

title: Dynamic Interest Reduction: A Data-Driven Approach to Adaptive Lending
affiliations: Ally Financial (Ally Financial Inc.)

detail.title: Dynamic Interest Reduction: A Data-Driven Approach to Adaptive Lending

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest related to this research
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study doesn't involve human participants clinical trials, or personally identifiable data requiring ethics approval
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding

detail.abstract: Traditional lending models rely on fixed or semi-fixed interest rates, ignoring the dynamic changes in borrower risk, asset performance, and macroeconomic conditions. This rigidity leads to inefficiencies such as higher default risks, suboptimal customer satisfaction, and revenue leakage for lenders. This paper introduces the Dynamic Interest Reduction (DIR) framework, an adaptive lending model that continuously recalibrates interest rates based on borrower behavior, asset performance (e.g., VIN-linked auto data), and market signals. By aligning customer incentives with responsible actions and real-time data, DIR enables lenders to reduce systemic risk, improve customer retention, and unlock significant cost savings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了动态利率降低（DIR）框架，这是一种基于借款人行为、资产表现和市场信号持续重新校准利率的自适应贷款模型，旨在解决传统固定利率贷款模型的低效率问题。
AI.research_question: 如何通过动态调整利率来改善贷款效率、降低违约风险并提高客户满意度？
AI.motivation: 传统贷款模型依赖固定或半固定利率，忽视了借款人风险、资产表现和宏观经济条件的动态变化，导致违约风险增加、客户满意度下降和收入流失。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自适应贷款模型、动态利率调整理论、风险定价理论
AI.method: 提出动态利率降低（DIR）框架，基于借款人行为、资产表现（如VIN链接的汽车数据）和市场信号持续重新校准利率。
AI.findings: DIR框架能够降低系统性风险、提高客户保留率，并为贷款机构带来显著的成本节约。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了动态利率调整的理论框架，将实时数据与客户激励机制相结合，丰富了自适应贷款模型的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为贷款机构提供了可操作的动态利率调整工具，能够改善风险管理、提升客户满意度并实现收入优化。

title: Bipartisan Betrayal: Human Rights, Policing Doctrine, and Hidden Taxation in Modern U.S. Governance
affiliations: Independent researcher

detail.title: Bipartisan Betrayal: Human Rights, Policing Doctrine, and Hidden Taxation in Modern U.S. Governance

declarations.funderStatement: No funder

detail.abstract: This working paper argues that continuity in U.S. administrative and fiscal mechanisms-rather than partisan alternation-best explains observed burdens on civil liberties and labor. Using Terry v. Ohio and its successor cases as a doctrinal baseline, the paper traces how stop-question-frisk-style discretion scaled nationally. It then examines post-Shelby County changes in election administration that raised participation costs for specific populations and analyzes tariffs as indirect taxes with regressive incidence, drawing on recent pass-through evidence. Case studies from the 1990s to the present illustrate a recurring toolkit-policing discretion, administrative levers over voting, and indirect fiscal instruments-that consistently imposes costs on working households while remaining formally neutral. Policy remedies include constrained and reviewable stop standards, auditable preclearance-style oversight for election changes, and ex ante distributional scoring with automatic review for indirect taxes. The contribution is integrative: a doctrinal, administrative, and fiscal account of policy continuity that reframes partisan narratives.

title: How to Apply Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Economics
affiliations: Universiti Kuala Lumpur Business School

detail.title: How to Apply Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Economics

declarations.funderStatement: NONE

detail.abstract:
This book is interested to present how to apply artificial intelligence (AI) in economics using Econographicology (Ruiz Estrada, 2017) as the main analytical and theoretical framework to support the application of AI in economics. This book is divided into twelve chapters.

The second chapter presents a simple methodology for using artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots in the policy modelling. The third chapter is interested to evaluate how artificial intelligence (AI) can help in the economic modeling. The fast development of AI, big data, data sciences, neural networks, and graphical models is opening opportunities to Economists and Academics to a new era under the uses of these alternative technologies. However, AI can replace the traditional way how we analyze and solve economic problems. In our case, this research presents an alternative economic method under the presentation of an application (theoretical framework) that is using AI, big data, data sciences, neural networks, and Econographicology simultaneously. The new electronic application is called “The Autonomous Economic Decision Maker Simulator (AEDM-Simulator). The fourth chapter is to provides an overview of the role of humanoid robots (HR) in the economy from a macroeconomic perspective. In the first section, we present a general introduction to robots. The second section offers a brief history of robots. The third section focuses on the basic requirements for building a humanoid robot (HR). In the fourth section, we delve into a microeconomic analysis of the impact of humanoid robots (HR) on firms, specifically regarding cost, revenue, and profit maximization. In the fifth section, we evaluate from a macroeconomic view, we assess the impact of humanoids robots (HR) on the productivity, unemployment, inflation, economic growth, income distribution, and international trade.

title: Less is More? The Effect of Reporting Frequency on Financial Reporting Quality
affiliations: and Florida International University

detail.title: Less is More? The Effect of Reporting Frequency on Financial Reporting Quality

declarations.funderStatement: Funding from universities

detail.abstract: Does more frequent financial reporting improve earnings quality-or does it backfire by encouraging short-termism? While regulators promote frequent disclosures for transparency, others warn it may harm reporting integrity. We exploit the UK's shift from quarterly to semiannual reporting to provide new empirical evidence on this. Utilizing a difference-indifferences design, we provide robust evidence on how reporting frequency influences key dimensions of financial reporting quality. Our findings reveal that semiannual reporting enhances accruals quality, earnings persistence, and predictability, while significantly reducing earnings manipulation and the propensity to narrowly meet or beat earnings benchmarks. Our analysis shows that transitioning from quarterly to semiannual reporting leads to improved accrual quality, a decline in earnings management, enhanced predictive value of earnings, and lower levels of opportunistic behavior. The results suggest that less frequent reporting enhances the quality and reliability of financial information by mitigating firms' short-term pressures. Our study offers a nuanced understanding of this dynamic by addressing methodological gaps in prior research, such as misclassification of reporting behaviors, and employing manual verification of staggered adoption periods. Our findings challenge the prevailing belief that more frequent reporting necessarily improves transparency, offering important implications for global regulatory policy. This research contributes uniquely to the discourse on financial transparency, emphasizing the role of reporting frequency in facilitating high-quality, reliable financial information.

AI.tldr: 研究发现减少财务报告频率（从季度改为半年度）能提高盈余质量，减少盈余操纵行为，挑战了更频繁报告必然提高透明度的传统观点。
AI.research_question: 更频繁的财务报告是否提高盈余质量，还是会因鼓励短期主义而产生反效果？

AI.findings: 半年度报告提高了应计质量、盈余持续性和可预测性，显著减少了盈余操纵和勉强达到盈余基准的倾向。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了更频繁报告必然提高透明度的传统观点，提供了报告频率与信息质量关系的新理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为全球监管政策提供重要启示，建议重新审视频繁报告的要求，强调报告质量而非频率的重要性。

title: AI, Digital Platforms, and the New Systemic Risk
affiliations: European University Viadrina Frankfurt (Oder) - European New School of Digital Studies, Carnegie Mellon University and Newcastle Law School

detail.title: AI, Digital Platforms, and the New Systemic Risk
detail.abstract: As artificial intelligence (AI) becomes increasingly embedded in digital, social, and institutional infrastructures, and AI and platforms are merged into hybrid structures, systemic risk has emerged as a critical but undertheorized challenge. In this paper, we develop a rigorous framework for understanding systemic risk in AI, platform, and hybrid system governance, drawing on insights from finance, complex systems theory, climate change, and cybersecurity-domains where systemic risk has already shaped regulatory responses. We argue that recent legislation, including the EU's AI Act and Digital Services Act (DSA), invokes systemic risk but relies on narrow or ambiguous definitions of this notion, sometimes reducing this risk to specific presence in frontier models, or to harms occurring in market settings. The DSA, we show, actually does a better job at identifying systemic risk than the more recent AI Act. Our framework highlights novel risk pathways, including the possibility of systemic failures arising from the interaction of multiple AI agents. We identify four levels of AI-related systemic risk and emphasize that discrimination at scale and systematic hallucinations, despite their capacity to destabilize institutions and fundamental rights, may not fall under current legal definitions, given the AI Act's focus on frontier models. We then test the DSA, the AI Act, and our own framework on five key examples-misuse for terrorism, large-scale discrimination, hallucinations, cybersecurity threats, and environmental effects-to illustrate their respective strengths and limitations. Against this background, this paper proposes reforms that broaden systemic risk assessments, strengthen coordination between regulatory regimes, and explicitly incorporate collective harms. As localized AI and platform failures may increasingly escalate into structural disruptions, we provide a conceptual foundation and policy-relevant diagnostic toolkit for governing AI in complex, interconnected societies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个理解AI、平台和混合系统中系统性风险的严谨框架，指出欧盟AI法案和数字服务法案对系统性风险的定义过于狭窄或模糊，并提出了扩展风险评估、加强监管协调的政策改革建议。

title: Prada Meets Versace: An Italian Luxury Consolidation
affiliations: Università degli Studi di Udine, Students and Independent

detail.title: Prada Meets Versace: An Italian Luxury Consolidation
detail.abstract: This paper analyses the financial conditions of Gianni Versace S.r.l. and estimates its value in the context of a potential merger and acquisition (M&A) transaction by the Prada Group. The study pursues a dual objective: to determine Versace’s economic value and to assess the potential synergies arising from the creation of an Italian luxury powerhouse capable of competing with French conglomerates. The methodology initially involves reclassifying Versace’s historical financial statements (covering the past 3–5 years) and conducting a financial analysis to evaluate profitability, capital structure, and liquidity. An examination of historical cash flows follows this to assess whether Versace can generate consistent cash flows. Subsequently, a five-year projected financial statement is developed, accompanied by the corresponding financial analysis, from which the Free Cash Flow to the Firm (FCFF) is then derived. The valuation of Versace will be carried out using three methods: the Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model and the Dividend Discount Model (DDM) as the primary financial approaches, complemented by a multiples-based valuation to provide a more comprehensive perspective. Finally, the paper offers an assessment of the transaction, exploring its potential impact on Prada as well as the risks associated with the M&A operation.

title: N. G. Butlin's 1959 Monograph "Colonial Socialism in Australia" and the Discourse in Economic History

declarations.funderStatement: N/a

detail.abstract: In 1959, an edited volume entitled The State and Economic Growth was published. It consisted of papers presented at a 1956 conference related to the same topic. Of interest here was the inclusion of N. G. Butlin's paper entitled "Colonial Socialism in Australia". The existence of colonial socialism in Australia has never been in doubt; nor has its importance to the development of the Australian economy ever been seriously questioned. What has been the subject of considerable contention has been the questions pertaining to what caused colonial socialism to be established in Australian colonies during a period of pronounced liberal thinking and what effects (good and bad) did the existence of colonial socialism have on Australian economic development generally and the development of private enterprise particularly? In this paper I review the position established by Butlin in his 1959 contribution and explore the subsequent discussion it generated both in terms of refinement and refutation. In doing so, I concentrate my discussion by reviewing the areas of employment, finance sourcing and railway investment in the context of the effects this activity had on the capacity of the private sector to develop in such an environment.

title: Predicting Physical Inactivity Risk in Middle-Aged and Older Adults: A Machine Learning Approach Using Longitudinal Data

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Disclosure of interest: The authors report no conflict of interest
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval: This study applies second hand data from Harmonized China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study (H_CHARLS). The ethical approval for the dataset was obtained before commencing the CHARLS project.

detail.abstract: Physical inactivity risk (PIR) in middle-aged and older adults arises from a complex mix of individual, interpersonal, household, and societal factors, yet integrated analyses remain limited. This study employs a two-step machine learning approach grounded in a social-ecological framework. Least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (Lasso) reduces 64 candidate predictors across individual, interpersonal, and family domains to 38 key variables, minimizing bias from prior assumptions. Subsequently, a rolling Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) classifier identifies the top 20 factors most strongly associated with PIR, with SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) used to interpret predictor contributions. Findings reveal PIR is influenced by various demographic, socioeconomic, health, behavioral factors across individual, interpersonal, and family levels; nonetheless, the decline in social interaction associated with reduced working hours stands out as a significant contributor. This study demonstrates that recent advances in ML can uncover complex, non-linear predictors of PIR that conventional variable selection methods may overlook. The integration of Lasso and rolling XGBoost provides a robust data-driven framework for identifying key risk factors, offering valuable insights for targeted interventions in aging and urbanizing populations.

title: Law and the Art of Modeling: Are Models Facts?

detail.title: Law and the Art of Modeling: Are Models Facts?
detail.abstract:
In 2013, the Supreme Court made the offhand comment that empirical models and their estimations or predictions are not “findings of fact” deserving of deference on appeal. The four Justices writing in dissent disagreed, insisting that an assessment of how a model works and its ability to measure what it claims to measure are precisely the kinds of factual findings that the Court, absent clear error, cannot disturb. Neither side elaborated on the controversy or defended its position doctrinally or normatively. That the highest Court could split 5–4 on such a crucial issue without even mentioning the stakes or the terms of the debate, suggests that something is amiss in the legal understanding of models and modeling.

This Article does what that case failed to do: it tackles the issue head-on, defining the legal status of a scientific model’s results and of the assumptions and choices that go into its construction. I argue that as a normative matter, models and their conclusions should not be treated like facts. Models are better evaluated by a judge, they do not merit total deference on appeal, and modeling choices are at least somewhat susceptible to analogical reasoning between cases. But I show that as a descriptive matter, courts often treat models and their outcomes like issues of fact, despite doctrines like Daubert that encourage serious judicial engagement with modeling. I suggest that a perceived mismatch between ability and task leads judges to take the easier route of treating modeling issues as facts, and I caution that when judges avoid hard questions about modeling, they jeopardize their own power and influence.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨科学模型在司法系统中的法律地位，认为模型及其结论不应被视为事实，而应由法官评估，不应在上诉中获得完全尊重。
AI.research_question: 科学模型的结果及其构建过程中的假设和选择在法律上应被赋予何种地位？

AI.theoretical_framework: 法律事实认定理论、科学模型在司法中的应用理论、司法审查标准理论
AI.method: 规范分析和描述分析相结合的方法，探讨模型在法律中的应然地位和实然状况

title: The Bangladesh Startup Ecosystem: A Comprehensive Analysis of Challenges, Opportunities, and a Strategic Roadmap for Sustainable Growth
affiliations: University of National

detail.title: The Bangladesh Startup Ecosystem: A Comprehensive Analysis of Challenges, Opportunities, and a Strategic Roadmap for Sustainable Growth
detail.abstract: This report provides a comprehensive analysis of the evolving startup ecosystem in Bangladesh, examining its foundational characteristics, recent growth trajectory, and the critical challenges it faces. The analysis distinguishes a genuine startup from a traditional business, emphasizing the core principles of technology-driven scalability and market leadership. The report leverages case studies of successful ventures like bKash and ShopUp alongside the high-profile failure of Evaly to illustrate key success factors and systemic vulnerabilities. It scrutinizes major bottlenecks, including a significant local funding gap, socio-cultural barriers such as social stigma and a talent shortage, and operational deficiencies stemming from imitative business models. A comparative analysis with regional peers like India and Vietnam highlights the unique structural and cultural impediments holding back Bangladesh's progress. The report concludes with a multi-stakeholder strategic roadmap, offering actionable recommendations for policymakers, investors, and founders to foster a more mature, resilient, and sustainable ecosystem poised for long-term growth and global competitiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文对孟加拉国初创企业生态系统进行了全面分析，区分了真正初创企业与传统企业的差异，通过成功案例（bKash、ShopUp）和失败案例（Evaly）研究关键成功因素和系统脆弱性，识别了资金缺口、社会文化障碍和运营缺陷等主要瓶颈，并与印度、越南等区域同行进行比较，最后提出了多利益相关者战略路线图。
AI.research_question: 孟加拉国初创企业生态系统的发展现状、关键挑战以及如何构建更成熟、有韧性和可持续的生态系统？
AI.motivation: 分析孟加拉国初创生态系统的演变轨迹，识别其结构性障碍和系统性脆弱性，为政策制定者、投资者和创始人提供可行的战略建议。
AI.theoretical_framework: 初创企业理论、生态系统发展理论、比较分析框架
AI.method: 案例研究（bKash、ShopUp、Evaly）、比较分析（与印度、越南对比）、系统性瓶颈识别
AI.findings: 孟加拉国初创生态系统面临显著的本地资金缺口、社会文化障碍（社会污名、人才短缺）和运营缺陷（模仿性商业模式）；成功案例显示技术驱动的可扩展性和市场领导力是关键成功因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对新兴市场初创生态系统发展的理解，提出了区分真正初创企业与传统企业的核心原则，丰富了生态系统脆弱性分析的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、投资者和创始人提供了具体的战略路线图和可操作建议，有助于构建更具韧性和全球竞争力的初创生态系统。

title: Move a Little Closer? Information Sharing and the Spatial Clustering of Bank Branches
affiliations: Xiamen University - School of Management, European Bank for Reconstruction and Development, University of Zurich - Department Finance and Maastricht University

detail.title: Move a Little Closer? Information Sharing and the Spatial Clustering of Bank Branches
detail.abstract: We study how information sharing between banks influences the geographical clustering of branches. We construct a spatial oligopoly model with price competition that explains why bank branches cluster and how the introduction of information sharing impacts clustering. Dynamic data on 59,333 branches operated by 676 banks in 22 countries between 1995 and 2012 allow us to test the hypotheses derived from our model. We find that information sharing spurs banks to open branches in localities that are new to them, but that are already well served by other banks. Information sharing also allows firms to borrow from more distant banks.

AI.tldr: 信息共享促使银行在已有其他银行服务的地区开设新分行，并允许企业从更远的银行借款，从而影响银行分行的地理集聚模式。
AI.research_question: 信息共享如何影响银行分行的地理集聚？
AI.motivation: 研究银行分行集聚现象及其与信息共享机制的关系，理解银行网络扩张的驱动因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 空间寡头竞争模型，包含价格竞争和信息共享机制。
AI.method: 使用1995-2012年间22个国家676家银行的59,333家分行的动态数据，检验模型推导的假设。
AI.findings: 信息共享促使银行在已有其他银行服务的地区开设新分行；信息共享允许企业从更远的银行借款。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了包含信息共享的空间寡头竞争模型，解释了银行分行集聚的形成机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行网络扩张决策和监管政策制定提供理论依据，有助于理解信息共享对金融地理格局的影响。

title: External Audit Importance Toward Efficiency of Public Funds and the Economic Growth-A Study Case of Kosovo
affiliations: , AAB College and

detail.title: External Audit Importance Toward Efficiency of Public Funds and the Economic Growth-A Study Case of Kosovo
detail.abstract: The purpose of this study is to shed light on the importance of the external audit towards the efficiency of public funds and to estimate further the impact of related macroeconomic determinants such as government expenditures, government debt to GDP, government revenue, and fiscal expenditure in economic growth in the case of Kosovo. The study employs a quantitative research method utilizing secondary data from 2012-2021 sourced from World Bank indicators. The econometric models employed in this study are the OLS and VAR models. The study finds that a point increase in public debt will decrease the GDP growth in the case of Kosovo. The empirical findings suggest further that an increase in government spending leads to a rise in GDP growth, whereas government revenues and fiscal expenditures are statistically not significant in the study circumstances. Budgetary expenditure is negatively signed, indicating that an increase in fiscal expenditure leads to a decrease in GDP growth, and it is statistically not significant. The study concludes that external audits play a crucial role in the efficiency of public funds and sheds light on macroeconomic determinants related to external audits that have an impact on economic growth in the case of Kosovo.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨外部审计对公共资金效率的重要性，并评估科索沃案例中政府支出、政府债务占GDP比重、政府收入和财政支出等宏观经济决定因素对经济增长的影响。研究发现公共债务增加会降低GDP增长，政府支出增加促进GDP增长，而政府收入和财政支出在统计上不显著。
AI.research_question: 外部审计对公共资金效率的重要性以及相关宏观经济决定因素（政府支出、政府债务、政府收入、财政支出）对科索沃经济增长的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 阐明外部审计在公共资金效率中的重要性，并评估科索沃案例中宏观经济决定因素对经济增长的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于公共财政理论和经济增长理论，探讨外部审计与公共资金效率的关系，以及宏观经济变量对经济增长的影响机制。
AI.method: 采用定量研究方法，使用2012-2021年世界银行指标的二手数据，运用OLS和VAR计量经济模型进行分析。
AI.findings: 1. 公共债务增加会降低GDP增长；2. 政府支出增加促进GDP增长；3. 政府收入和财政支出在统计上不显著；4. 财政支出与GDP增长呈负相关但不显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 为外部审计在公共资金效率中的作用提供了实证支持，深化了对科索沃特定背景下宏观经济决定因素与经济增长关系的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为科索沃政策制定者提供了关于公共债务管理、政府支出优化和外部审计重要性的实践指导，有助于提高公共资金使用效率和促进经济增长。

title: A Panel Analysis of the Determinants of Nonperforming Loans in the Western Balkans Countries
affiliations: and

detail.title: A Panel Analysis of the Determinants of Nonperforming Loans in the Western Balkans Countries
detail.abstract: Nonperforming loans are crucial factor for measurement of the financial stability. This study aims to present the determinants which impact the nonperforming loans in the case of the Western Balkans. The study goes further to present the trends of nonperforming loans in the case of Western Balkan Countries such as Albania, North Macedonia, Montenegro, Bosnia and Hercegovina and Serbia. The data used are secondary data obtained from the official web site of World Bank Indicators and cover the time period 2000-2022. In order to measure the impact of some key determinants in nonperforming loans in the case of the Western Balkans, the econometric models are used. The study employs the mostly common econometric models used for panel data estimation such as the Pooled OLS, Fixed effect, Random Effect and Hausman Test. In the econometric modelling there are also used the panel data test. The study comes to conclusion that nonperforming loans in the case of the Western Balkans under period of investigation are impacted from employment and unemployment thus one percent increase will lead to decrease the nonperforming loans. The determinants of savings, inflation, and interest rates will cause the increasement of nonperforming loans in the case of the Western Balkans Countries.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了2000-2022年西巴尔干地区不良贷款的决定因素，发现就业和失业率上升会减少不良贷款，而储蓄、通胀和利率上升会增加不良贷款。
AI.research_question: 西巴尔干地区不良贷款的决定因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 不良贷款是衡量金融稳定性的关键因素，了解其决定因素对西巴尔干地区的金融稳定具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于不良贷款决定因素的相关理论，包括宏观经济变量对银行资产质量的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用面板数据计量经济学模型，包括混合OLS、固定效应、随机效应模型和Hausman检验，数据来源于世界银行指标数据库（2000-2022年）。
AI.findings: 就业和失业率上升会减少不良贷款，而储蓄、通胀和利率上升会增加西巴尔干地区的不良贷款。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了发展中国家特别是西巴尔干地区不良贷款决定因素的实证研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为西巴尔干地区银行监管机构和政策制定者提供了管理不良贷款的政策参考，有助于维护金融稳定。

title: Collective-Conscious Integration: Rethinking the Foundations of World Government in the Age of Global Crisis

detail.title: Collective-Conscious Integration: Rethinking the Foundations of World Government in the Age of Global Crisis
detail.abstract: This article introduces the theory of Collective-Conscious Integration (CCI), a new framework for global governance that proposes the ethical, conscious, and voluntary delegation of sovereign authority by states to construct a legitimate and effective world government. The failure of existing international institutions to manage transnational crises-climate change, pandemics, war, and forced migration-highlights the need for a new theoretical foundation. Drawing on comparative institutional models and integrating both political realism and normative theory, this article critiques earlier approaches to world government-such as regionalism, functionalism, and cosmopolitanism-for their inability to reconcile legitimacy, enforceability, and inclusiveness. It then outlines a roadmap for institutional reform, centered on the creation of a UN Secretary-General-mandated Ad Hoc Task Force as a constitutional incubator for planetary governance. CCI offers a principled yet pragmatic roadmap to world government that centers on democratic ethics and shared human responsibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出集体意识整合理论（CCI），这是一个全球治理新框架，主张国家通过道德、有意识和自愿的主权授权来构建合法有效的世界政府。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一个既合法又有效的世界政府来应对跨国危机？
AI.motivation: 现有国际机构在应对气候变化、流行病、战争和强迫移民等跨国危机方面失败，需要新的理论基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 集体意识整合理论（CCI），整合政治现实主义和规范理论，批判区域主义、功能主义和世界主义等早期方法。
AI.method: 比较制度模型分析，整合政治现实主义和规范理论的方法论。
AI.findings: 现有世界政府方法无法调和合法性、可执行性和包容性，需要新的制度框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出集体意识整合理论（CCI），为世界政府提供新的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出以联合国秘书长授权的特设工作组作为行星治理宪法孵化器的制度改革路线图。

title: Enhancing Patient Value in Hospital Care: A Multi-Layered Identity Approach
affiliations: HAN University of Applied Science and General Union of Education

detail.title: Enhancing Patient Value in Hospital Care: A Multi-Layered Identity Approach

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Implementing value-based care frameworks such as Lean Management and Value Based Healthcare (VBHC) in hospitals requires a deep understanding of what patients value. This paper introduces the Multilayered Identity Approach (MIA), positing that healthcare recipients should be simultaneously viewed as patients, individuals, and customers, each with distinct but overlapping needs. By acknowledging these roles, hospitals can better design and deliver services that meet the dynamic and varied expectations of their patients. Anchored in existing literature on healthcare service quality, patient-centered care, and consumer behavior, this paper argues that recognizing the multi-faceted identity of patients offers new insights into improving the overall value of healthcare delivery. This paper further explores the theoretical and empirical foundations of these overlapping identities, providing a review of scientific literature while proposing potential avenues for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了多层身份方法(MIA)，认为医疗接受者应同时被视为患者、个体和客户，每个角色都有不同但重叠的需求。通过承认这些角色，医院能更好地设计和提供服务以满足患者动态多样的期望。
AI.research_question: 如何通过识别患者的多重身份角色来改善医疗服务的价值传递？
AI.motivation: 实施基于价值的医疗框架需要深入理解患者的价值需求，而传统方法可能未能充分考虑患者的多重身份特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于医疗服务质量、以患者为中心的护理和消费者行为理论的文献基础，构建多层身份方法(MIA)理论框架。
AI.method: 文献综述方法，回顾科学文献并探索这些重叠身份的理论和实证基础。
AI.findings: 认识到患者的多方面身份为改善医疗服务整体价值提供了新的见解，患者应同时被视为患者、个体和客户。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了多层身份方法(MIA)理论框架，扩展了对患者身份复杂性的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医院设计和提供满足患者动态期望的服务提供了实践指导，有助于提升医疗服务价值。

title: Self-Nudging using the Digital Wellbeing App
affiliations: Universidade Lusófona, Lisbon, Universitat de Barcelona, City University of New York, IE University and

detail.title: Self-Nudging using the Digital Wellbeing App

publicationDetails.detailsText: International Conference on Computer-Human Interaction Research and Applications (CHIRA) 2025

detail.abstract: Design of smartphones and their apps can conflict with users' personal goals and negatively impact well-being, motivating tech companies to develop tools aimed at self-monitoring and altering smartphone usage. This mixed-method study describes the use of self-nudges within Android's native Digital Wellbeing app as a tool to achieve smartphone usage goals. Students (N = 63) were encouraged to use the Digital Wellbeing app for several weeks, but were given the freedom to select their preferred strategies to curb smartphone usage. Specifically, they could set personal smartphone usage goals and employ features like app 'Time Limits', "Grayscale" mode, and "Focus" mode. Results revealed that 58% of participants reported using at least one Digital Wellbeing feature. App time limits were the most utilized, reported by 62.2% of participants, followed by "Do not disturb" mode (43.2%), and "Grayscale" mode (32.4%). Despite this, participants did not rate the Digital Wellbeing app as particularly useful, regardless of whether they used features of the app or not. Participants reported no significant differences in life satisfaction, sleep quality, stress, and happiness before versus after the intervention period. Therefore, self-nudging with the Digital Wellbeing app might not be sufficiently useful and effective due to low engagement and lack of enforcement mechanisms in the app's tools, which are often bypassed. Based on our findings, we propose implications for future design of digital well being tools, including the integrations of behavioral insights, centering interventions around activity patterns, lowering barriers for uses of those apps, and leveraging machine learning algorithms to adjust intervention strategies over time.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了Android原生数字健康应用中的自我助推策略对智能手机使用行为的影响。研究发现，虽然58%的参与者使用了至少一种数字健康功能，但应用时间限制是最常用的功能。然而，参与者普遍认为该应用并不特别有用，且在生活满意度、睡眠质量、压力和幸福感方面没有显著改善。研究指出，由于参与度低和缺乏强制机制，数字健康应用可能不够有效。
AI.research_question: 数字健康应用中的自我助推策略是否能有效帮助用户实现智能手机使用目标？
AI.motivation: 智能手机及其应用的设计可能与用户的个人目标相冲突，并对幸福感产生负面影响，这促使科技公司开发旨在自我监控和改变智能手机使用行为的工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自我助推理论、行为改变理论
AI.method: 混合方法研究，63名学生被鼓励使用Android数字健康应用数周，可以自由选择偏好的策略来限制智能手机使用，包括设置使用目标、应用时间限制、灰度模式和专注模式等。
AI.findings: 58%的参与者使用了至少一种数字健康功能；应用时间限制是最常用的功能（62.2%），其次是"请勿打扰"模式（43.2%）和灰度模式（32.4%）；参与者普遍认为该应用并不特别有用；在生活满意度、睡眠质量、压力和幸福感方面没有显著改善。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了数字健康应用中自我助推策略的局限性，提出了行为洞察整合、围绕活动模式设计干预、降低使用障碍以及利用机器学习算法调整干预策略的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为未来数字健康工具的设计提供了实践启示，包括需要更强的执行机制、更低的参与门槛以及更智能的个性化干预策略。

title: Asymmetric Corporate Tax Compliance: Evidence from a Tax Reform in China
affiliations: University of Texas at Austin, Durham University and Xiamen University - School of Management

detail.title: Asymmetric Corporate Tax Compliance: Evidence from a Tax Reform in China
detail.abstract: Using the 2008 corporate tax reform in China as a quasi-natural experiment, we find that compared to unaffected firms, firms facing tax increases report significantly lower profit margins to avoid paying more taxes, while there is no significant difference for firms facing a tax cut. Our results remain valid after we control for firm fixed effects or instrument firms’ pre-reform tax rates by the plausibly exogenous historical variations in Qing China. We further find that tax increase firms only start to under-report their profits after 2008 when the tax reform became effective, no actions are undertaken in 2007 when the reform was announced. In contrast, tax cut firms under-report their profits in 2007 once they realized the tax decrease in the following years. Lastly, we find that the asymmetric reactions are only valid for private firms, but not for state-owned firms.

AI.tldr: 基于2008年中国企业所得税改革的准自然实验，研究发现：面临税率上升的企业会显著低报利润率以避税，而税率下降企业无显著差异；这种不对称反应仅存在于私营企业，国企无此现象；企业只在改革生效后才采取行动，而非在政策宣布时。
AI.research_question: 企业如何对税率变化做出不对称反应？税率上升和下降是否引发不同的利润报告行为？
AI.motivation: 理解企业在面对税收政策变化时的行为反应，特别是税率上升和下降是否会产生不对称的避税行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 税收规避理论、企业行为理论、代理理论
AI.method: 利用2008年中国企业所得税改革作为准自然实验，采用双重差分方法，控制企业固定效应，并使用清朝历史税率作为工具变量。
AI.findings: 1) 税率上升企业显著低报利润率避税，税率下降企业无显著差异；2) 税率上升企业只在改革生效后(2008年)才低报利润，税率下降企业在改革宣布年(2007年)就开始低报；3) 不对称反应仅存在于私营企业，国企无此现象。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了企业面对税率变化的不对称行为反应，拓展了税收规避理论，强调了企业所有权结构在税收行为中的调节作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为税收政策制定提供实证依据，提醒政策制定者关注税率上升可能引发的避税行为，特别是私营企业的反应模式。

title: Fundamental Persistence and Diagnostic Expectations
affiliations: Seoul National University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Fundamental Persistence and Diagnostic Expectations
detail.abstract: This paper reexamines the diagnostic expectations model by relaxing the restrictions to demonstrate that the current tool for detecting over-or underreaction to news can be misleading. Building on a state-space model of firm earnings with a latent AR(1) component, we allow the diagnostic distortion parameter to take positive (overreaction) or negative (underreaction) values, directly affecting the Kalman gain in investors' updating rules. The model provides closed-form expressions that link past earnings growth, forecasts, forecast errors, forecast revision, and stock returns, yielding three key theoretical results. First, high persistence with overreaction and low persistence with underreaction can generate identical forecast error patterns, making them observationally equivalent in standard empirical tests, such as the Coibion-Gorodnichenko regression. Second, the covariances between forecasts, forecast errors, and past performance change sign systematically with the interaction of persistence and diagnostic distortion, implying that inference on reaction direction requires joint identification. Third, pricing implications from the equity term structure model follow directly: return predictability mirrors the forecast error dynamics, with similar cross-sectional return spreads arising under both overreaction and underreaction regimes. A counterexample case from the Korean stock market, which exhibits low persistence and underreaction, empirically supports our theoretical results regarding an environment that the current literature has not considered.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视诊断预期模型，通过放宽限制证明了当前检测对新闻过度反应或反应不足的工具可能具有误导性。基于具有潜在AR(1)成分的公司盈利状态空间模型，允许诊断扭曲参数取正值（过度反应）或负值（反应不足），直接影响投资者更新规则中的卡尔曼增益。模型提供了连接过去盈利增长、预测、预测误差、预测修正和股票收益的闭式表达式，得出三个关键理论结果。
AI.research_question: 当前用于检测对新闻过度反应或反应不足的工具是否具有误导性？高持续性与过度反应、低持续性与反应不足是否会产生相同的预测误差模式？
AI.motivation: 重新审视诊断预期模型，放松限制条件，揭示当前检测工具可能存在的误导性，特别是在不同持续性环境下对反应方向的识别问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于具有潜在AR(1)成分的公司盈利状态空间模型，诊断扭曲参数直接影响投资者更新规则中的卡尔曼增益，允许参数取正值（过度反应）或负值（反应不足）。
AI.method: 构建状态空间模型，推导闭式表达式连接盈利增长、预测、预测误差、预测修正和股票收益，进行理论分析，并使用韩国股市案例进行实证支持。
AI.findings: 1）高持续性与过度反应、低持续性与反应不足会产生相同的预测误差模式，在标准实证检验中观测等价；2）预测、预测误差和过去表现的协方差随持续性与诊断扭曲的相互作用系统性变化；3）股票收益可预测性反映了预测误差动态，在过度反应和反应不足机制下都会产生类似的横截面收益差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了当前检测工具在识别反应方向时的局限性，提出了需要联合识别持续性和诊断扭曲的理论框架，完善了诊断预期模型的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实证研究者提供了更准确的检测方法，避免对反应方向的误判，特别是在低持续性和反应不足的环境中，韩国股市案例提供了实证支持。

title: The International Arbitration Recognized the Fair Decision of the Central Bank of the Republic of Kosovo

detail.title: The International Arbitration Recognized the Fair Decision of the Central Bank of the Republic of Kosovo
detail.abstract: Iute Credit Microfinance Institution was registered on 27 October 2017, with which registration it is authorized to carry out financial activities of granting loans. Through its licensing policy, the CBK continuously aims to provide the best possible conditions for access to finance in Kosovo, enabling the operation in our financial market only of institutions that contribute to the stability and development of the financial system and, consequently, the sustainable economic development of the country. During the period of operation of Iute Credit in Kosovo, this institution has continuously deviated from the business plan, based on which it had received the license to operate, thus bringing to our market something different from what it had promised.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了Iute Credit小额信贷机构在科索沃运营期间持续偏离其商业计划的问题，以及这对科索沃金融体系稳定和经济发展的影响。
AI.research_question: Iute Credit小额信贷机构在科索沃运营期间如何偏离其获得许可的商业计划？这种偏离对科索沃金融体系稳定和经济发展的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 科索沃中央银行通过许可政策旨在为科索沃提供最佳的融资条件，但Iute Credit机构在运营期间持续偏离其商业计划，这引发了对其对金融体系稳定性和国家经济可持续发展贡献的担忧。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融监管理论、小额信贷机构治理理论、金融机构合规性理论
AI.method: 案例分析法，基于Iute Credit机构在科索沃的运营数据和监管记录进行分析
AI.findings: Iute Credit机构在科索沃运营期间持续偏离其获得许可的商业计划，未能兑现其承诺，这可能对科索沃金融体系的稳定性和国家的经济可持续发展产生负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 为小额信贷机构监管和合规性研究提供了实证案例，深化了对金融机构偏离商业计划行为影响的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为科索沃中央银行和其他监管机构提供了加强金融机构监管的实践参考，强调了金融机构严格遵守许可条件的重要性

publicationDetails.detailsText: Rasche, A. (2025). The Ethics of ESG Integration: Ethical Dilemmas of Quantification, in: Gentile, V. et al. (eds). The Ethics of ESG: Critically Assessing the Environmental, Social and Governance Movement. Cambridge/New York: Cambridge University Press

detail.abstract: The market for Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG)-related investing has been growing swiftly. While the volume was $18.4 trillion in 2022, it is projected to grow to $30.9 trillion by 2032 due to increasing government regulation and growing client awareness (Global Market Insights, 2022). ESG investing is often practiced as so-called ESG integration – an investment approach aimed at incorporating the assessment of ESG characteristics deeply into the “normal” investment process (Schoenmaker & Schramade, 2018; Serafeim, 2023). ESG integration therefore differs from other responsible investment approaches that aim at excluding companies from certain sin sectors from the investment portfolio (e.g., weapons) or reflect theme-based investments (e.g., into cleantech companies) (Kell, 2018; Rasche, 2023). While such approaches narrow the universe of potential investment targets, ESG integration does not exclude any companies or pre-selects certain sustainability themes. Rather it integrates sustainability into the risk-return calculation that investors make.

AI.tldr: ESG整合投资策略通过将ESG因素纳入传统投资流程的风险收益计算，区别于排除特定行业或主题投资的其他责任投资方法，该市场预计从2022年的18.4万亿美元增长到2032年的30.9万亿美元。
AI.research_question: ESG整合投资策略与其他责任投资方法有何本质区别？
AI.motivation: ESG投资市场快速增长，预计从2022年18.4万亿美元增长到2032年30.9万亿美元，需要理解ESG整合这一主流投资方法的独特性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Schoenmaker & Schramade (2018)和Serafeim (2023)的ESG整合理论框架，对比Kell (2018)和Rasche (2023)的其他责任投资方法。
AI.method: 概念性分析，通过文献综述比较ESG整合与其他责任投资方法的理论差异。
AI.findings: ESG整合不排除任何公司或预设可持续主题，而是将可持续性纳入投资风险收益计算，区别于排除特定行业或主题投资的方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 明确了ESG整合作为独立责任投资方法的理论定位，区别于排除法和主题投资法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了将ESG因素融入传统投资决策的实践指导，支持更全面的投资风险评估。

title: Designing Accountability: Ethical Frameworks for Reintroducing Responsibility in Executable Governance
affiliations: Universidad de la Republica

detail.title: Designing Accountability: Ethical Frameworks for Reintroducing Responsibility in Executable Governance
detail.abstract: This article develops an ethical legal framework for reintroducing responsibility into executable governance. Predictive systems, by generating authority without agents, displace accountability and leave institutions without appeal mechanisms. Building on the concepts of spectral sovereignty, null subjects, and the codex of authority, the paper introduces the notion of accountability injection as a design principle. It formulates a three tier model: (1) human, where non delegable critical decisions are tied to named subjects; (2) hybrid, where human judgment co exists with model output under calibrated thresholds; and (3) syntactic supervised, where delegation is permitted only with immutable ledgers, traceability, and automatic escalation triggers. Through applied case studies in EU AI Act conformity assessment, DAO governance, predictive credit scoring, and automated medical audits, the framework demonstrates how appeal and responsibility can be restored without undermining institutional efficiency. The conclusion argues that accountability must be compiled directly into the regla compilada of governance systems, creating a normative blueprint for legislators, courts, and regulators to maintain responsibility in predictive societies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个三层责任注入框架，通过人类决策、混合决策和语法监督三个层次，将问责机制直接编译到可执行治理系统中，以解决预测系统产生的无主体权威问题。
AI.research_question: 如何在预测系统中重新引入责任机制，同时保持制度效率？
AI.motivation: 预测系统通过生成无代理人的权威，取代了问责制，使机构缺乏上诉机制，需要建立新的责任框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于光谱主权、空主体和权威法典等概念，提出问责注入作为设计原则。
AI.method: 构建三层模型：人类决策层、混合决策层和语法监督层，并通过欧盟AI法案合规评估、DAO治理、预测性信用评分和自动化医疗审计等案例研究进行验证。
AI.findings: 该框架能够在保持制度效率的同时，恢复上诉和责任机制，为预测社会中的责任维护提供可行方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了问责注入的概念和三层责任模型，丰富了可执行治理理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为立法者、法院和监管机构提供了维护预测社会中责任的规范性蓝图，可直接应用于AI治理实践。

title: Monetary Discipline or Mirage? Assessing the Fundamentals of the ZiG An Evidence-Based Study of Value, Stability, and Credibility in Zimbabwe’s Gold-Backed Currency
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Monetary Discipline or Mirage? Assessing the Fundamentals of the ZiG An Evidence-Based Study of Value, Stability, and Credibility in Zimbabwe’s Gold-Backed Currency
detail.abstract:
Zimbabwe’s launch of the Zimbabwe Gold (ZiG) currency in April 2024 marks the latest attempt to stabilise a monetary system long undermined by hyperinflation, currency collapses, and reliance on the United States dollar. Marketed as a “structured currency” backed by gold and foreign exchange reserves, ZiG was presented by the Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe (RBZ) as a vehicle to restore confidence, reduce dollarisation, and reclaim monetary sovereignty.

This paper examines the fundamentals underpinning the ZiG and the forces that shape its value. It traces Zimbabwe’s monetary history from the fall of the Zimbabwe dollar through successive interim currencies, framing the discussion within the theoretical contrast between fiat and commodity-backed money. The analysis identifies core determinants of ZiG’s stability: adequacy of reserve backing, money supply discipline, inflation dynamics, convertibility enforcement, parallel market pressures, external sector flows, and institutional credibility. Quantitative tools such as the reserve-backing ratio and exchange rate differentials are employed to assess value sustainability.

The findings highlight persistent risks: weak institutional trust, fiscal indiscipline, uncertain convertibility, gold price volatility, and reserve depletion. Comparative insights from the classical Gold Standard, Bretton Woods, Peru’s de-dollarisation, and Ghana’s gold policies underscore that lasting success requires transparency, fiscal restraint, and credible institutions.

The study concludes with scenario-based projections. While ZiG could provide a credible anchor for price stability and economic re-monetisation, its survival depends less on the promise of gold than on the practice of governance. Without consistent reserve management and disciplined policy, ZiG risks becoming another fleeting chapter in Zimbabwe’s turbulent monetary history.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了津巴布韦2024年4月推出的津巴布韦黄金货币（ZiG），探讨其作为黄金和外汇储备支持的"结构化货币"能否稳定长期受恶性通胀、货币崩溃和美元依赖困扰的货币体系。研究发现ZiG的稳定性取决于储备充足性、货币供应纪律、通胀动态、可兑换性执行等因素，但面临机构信任薄弱、财政纪律松懈等风险。
AI.research_question: 津巴布韦黄金货币（ZiG）的基本支撑因素是什么？哪些力量塑造其价值？
AI.motivation: 津巴布韦长期面临恶性通胀、货币崩溃和美元依赖问题，ZiG作为最新尝试的"结构化货币"，旨在恢复信心、减少美元化并重获货币主权。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法定货币与商品支持货币的理论对比，借鉴古典金本位制、布雷顿森林体系、秘鲁去美元化和加纳黄金政策的比较见解。
AI.method: 采用定量工具如储备支持比率和汇率差异来评估价值可持续性，分析津巴布韦从津巴布韦元崩溃到连续临时货币的货币历史。
AI.findings: 识别出ZiG稳定性的核心决定因素：储备支持充足性、货币供应纪律、通胀动态、可兑换性执行、平行市场压力、外部部门流动和机构可信度，但存在机构信任薄弱、财政纪律松懈等持续风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 为商品支持货币在现代经济环境中的可行性提供了理论分析框架，丰富了法定货币与商品货币对比的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了ZiG成功实施的关键条件：透明度、财政约束和可信机构，并基于情景的预测为类似经济体的货币改革提供参考。

title: Hidden Weaknesses: The Role of Unrealized Losses in Monetary Policy Transmission
affiliations: Alma Mater Studiorum University of Bologna, , European Central Bank (ECB) and European Central Bank (ECB)

detail.title: Hidden Weaknesses: The Role of Unrealized Losses in Monetary Policy Transmission

publicationDetails.journalName: ECB: Working Paper Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: This paper investigates how unrealized losses on banks’ amortized cost securities affect monetary policy transmission to bank lending in the euro area. Leveraging the sharp increase in interest rates between 2022 and 2023 and using granular supervisory data on security holdings and loan-level credit register data, we show that a one percentage point increase in the share of unrealized losses on amortized cost securities amplifies the contractionary effect of monetary tightening on lending supply by approximately one percentage point. This effect is more pronounced for weakly capitalized and less liquid banks, and those relying more on uninsured deposits. We further document that banks respond to growing unrealized losses by raising capital and passing through interest rate increases to depositors via higher deposit betas. Importantly, banks that employ interest rate hedging strategies can fully offset the negative impact of unrealized losses on credit supply. The contraction in lending is particularly severe for smaller borrowing firms, highlighting the uneven economic consequences of hidden balance sheet fragilities during a tightening cycle.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现银行摊销成本证券的未实现损失会放大货币紧缩政策对银行贷款的收缩效应，特别是在资本薄弱、流动性较差、依赖无保险存款的银行中更为明显。
AI.research_question: 银行摊销成本证券的未实现损失如何影响欧元区货币政策向银行信贷的传导？
AI.motivation: 利用2022-2023年利率急剧上升的背景，研究隐藏的资产负债表脆弱性对货币政策传导的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币政策传导机制、银行资产负债表脆弱性理论、信贷供给理论
AI.method: 使用证券持有和贷款级信贷登记的细粒度监管数据，分析未实现损失与货币政策传导的关系

detail.title: A Tale of Two Transitions: Mobility Dynamics in the People’s Republic of China and Russia After Central Planning

publicationDetails.detailsText: ADB Economics Working Paper Series No. 807
publicationDetails.journalName: ADB Economics Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines intergenerational mobility in the People’s Republic of China (PRC) and Russia during their transitions from central planning to market systems. We consider mobility as movement captured by changes in status between parents and children. We provide estimates of overall mobility, which involves mobility during transition to a system’s steady state, as well as steady state mobility, which captures long-run mobility independent of transitional dynamics or shifts in the marginal distribution of outcomes across generations. We further decompose overall mobility into structural and exchange components. We find that the PRC exhibits more overall educational mobility than Russia, mostly because of greater structural mobility, whereas Russia exhibits greater steady-state educational mobility. In contrast, both overall and steady state occupational mobility are similar in the PRC and Russia. Comparing these results to the United States (US), we find steady state mobility in education is substantially higher in the US and Russia compared to the PRC, but occupational steady state mobility is comparable in all three countries.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了中国和俄罗斯在从计划经济向市场经济转型过程中的代际流动性。研究发现中国在整体教育流动性方面高于俄罗斯，但俄罗斯的稳态教育流动性更高；两国在职业流动性方面相似。与美国相比，美国和俄罗斯的稳态教育流动性都显著高于中国，但三国的职业稳态流动性相当。
AI.research_question: 中国和俄罗斯在从计划经济向市场经济转型过程中的代际流动性有何差异？
AI.motivation: 研究转型经济体中的代际流动性，比较不同国家在制度转型过程中的社会流动模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代际流动性理论，包括整体流动性、稳态流动性、结构流动性和交换流动性的概念框架。
AI.method: 比较分析方法，分解整体流动性为结构性和交换性成分，估计稳态流动性。
AI.findings: 中国整体教育流动性高于俄罗斯（主要由于结构性流动性），但俄罗斯稳态教育流动性更高；两国职业流动性相似；与美国相比，美俄稳态教育流动性显著高于中国，三国职业稳态流动性相当。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了转型经济体代际流动性的分析框架，区分了整体流动性和稳态流动性，提供了跨国比较的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解不同转型路径对社会流动性的影响提供实证依据，对政策制定者设计促进社会流动的政策具有参考价值。

title: Productivity and Growth in Canada: The Role of Procompetitive Reforms
affiliations: Neoma Business School, LEDi, LUISS Lab of European Economics and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Productivity and Growth in Canada: The Role of Procompetitive Reforms

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The study was funded by the Canadian Competition Bureau
declarations.funderStatement: The study was funded by the Canadian Competition Bureau

detail.abstract: This paper explores how regulations that restrict competition in key Canadian nonmanufacturing sectors-such as energy, transport, retail, and professional services-have contributed to the country's long-standing productivity gap with the United States. Using international data on anticompetitive regulations and productivity from 15 countries and a large number of industries over the 1996-2021 period, the study finds that these upstream sectors, which supply essential inputs to the rest of the economy, play a central role in shaping overall productivity performance. Simulations suggest that if Canada were to adopt best international practices in regulating these sectors, GDP per capita could rise in the very long term by nearly 10%, equivalent to a total gain of CAD 300 billion or about CAD 7,500 per person. Spread over 5-10 years, this would mean annual gains of CAD 750 to 1,500 per person-corresponding to roughly half the current income gap with the US. The largest gains would come from procompetitive reforms in professional services and retail distribution. These estimates are conservative, as they exclude the effects of improved efficiency in regulated sectors themselves, ignore additional gains from reducing internal trade barriers and restrictions on foreign investment and do not account for potentially productivity-enhancing changes in industry structure originating from reforms. Overall, the findings highlight the major economic benefits Canada could reap from implementing a deeper and swifter pro-competitive reform agenda than in the past.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现加拿大关键非制造业部门的竞争限制法规是造成其与美国长期生产力差距的主要原因。通过国际数据模拟显示，如果加拿大在这些上游部门采用最佳国际监管实践，长期内人均GDP可提升近10%，相当于人均收益约7500加元，能弥补约一半的当前收入差距。
AI.research_question: 加拿大关键非制造业部门的竞争限制法规如何影响其与美国的生产力差距？
AI.motivation: 加拿大长期存在与美国的生产力差距，需要探索其根本原因，特别是上游非制造业部门的监管限制对整体经济生产力的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于竞争经济学理论，关注上游部门（能源、运输、零售、专业服务）作为经济关键投入品供应者的角色，及其对整体生产力的传导效应。
AI.method: 使用1996-2021年间15个国家和大量行业的反竞争法规与生产力国际数据进行实证分析，并进行政策模拟。
AI.findings: 上游非制造业部门的竞争限制是加拿大生产力差距的主要因素；采用最佳国际监管实践可使人均GDP长期提升近10%（3000亿加元总收益）；专业服务和零售分销领域的改革收益最大。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对上游部门监管限制如何通过供应链传导影响整体生产力的理论理解；提供了竞争政策改革对宏观经济影响的新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加拿大政策制定者提供了具体的改革方向和预期收益估算；表明竞争改革可弥补约一半的美加收入差距；强调了专业服务和零售分销作为改革优先领域的重要性。

detail.abstract: This study investigates the impact of working capital management (WCM) on profitability in the Indian cement industry, an energy-intensive sector central to the country's infrastructure growth. Using a balanced panel of listed firms over 2010-2024, we employ pooled OLS, two-way fixed effects, quantile regressions, and dynamic system GMM to address heterogeneity and endogeneity concerns. The results demonstrate that reductions in the cash conversion cycle (CCC), accelerated receivables collection, leaner inventories, and prudent use of payables significantly improve profitability. Quantile regressions reveal that highly profitable firms capture larger absolute gains from CCC reductions, while sizesplit analysis indicates that smaller and liquidity-constrained firms achieve proportionally greater marginal relief. These findings represent complementary perspectives rather than unified statistical relationship, a limitation we acknowledge. Dynamic estimates confirm the robustness of results after accounting for persistence and reverse causality. Beyond firm-level outcomes, the study contributes conceptually by linking WCM efficiency to sustainability financing: liquidity released from shorter operating cycles can be redeployed into green and energy-efficient investments, offering a potential channel for ESG alignment in carbon-intensive industries. Policy implications highlight the role of digital reforms such as TReDS and e-invoicing in strengthening liquidity efficiency, particularly for midsized firms. The findings extend the international WCM profitability literature, provide sector-specific evidence for India, and suggest new avenues for integrating financial and sustainability strategies.

detail.title: Public Debt Dynamics and Exchange Rate in Nigeria

publicationDetails.detailsText: Sri Lankan Journal of Business Economics, 2025 14 (I)

detail.abstract: In light of the persistent exchange rate depreciation and growing public debt in Nigeria over the last years, this study examined the dynamics between public debt and exchange rate in Nigeria. The study objective was to look at how external and domestic debts affect exchange rate in Nigeria. Using secondary data analysed through times series analysis with data for 43 years (1981-2023), the ARDL cointegration test was used because the data were composed of I(0) and I(1) variables. The result showed that there is no long-run relationship between public debts and exchange rate. However, there was evidence of a structural break, which then require running a pre and post-structural break analysis. External debt showed to reduce exchange rate pre-structural break, but it was insignificant. After structural break, external debt became positively significant on increasing the exchange rate. Domestic debt shows a positive relationship with exchange rate pre and post structural break. While it was insignificant pre 1999, it became significant after 1999. Debt servicing positively add to increasing exchange rate pre and post structural break but was only significant pre-structural break. Foreign reserve similar to debt servicing also have a positive relationship with exchange rate pre and post-structural break but only significant after the structural break. Using the granger causality test, there was no causation between public debts and exchange rate. Based on the research findings, the study recommends that external debts should be utilised for capital expenditures rather than recurrent expenditures to enhance future economic returns and the productive capacity of the economy. This recommendation is crucial due to the significant burden on Nigeria's reserves from the country's reliance on imports, which contributes to high exchange rates.

detail.abstract:
Both, around the world and in Kosovo, recent years have been quite challenging and characterized by a high degree of uncertainty, for the financial system and the economy of the country. As a result of the adequate regulatory framework as well as high supervisory standards, the pandemic situation found the financial system in Kosovo with high levels of capital and liquidity as well as very good quality of assets.

Also, prudent measures taken by the CBK in cooperation with financial institutions operating in Kosovo have been shown to be very effective in maintaining financial stability and minimizing the consequences for the country’s economy in general.

As a result of these measures, the banking sector managed to maintain a high degree of resilience to the impact of the crisis and to meet very well the challenges and implications of the pandemic, and to play a very important role in the recovery of the economy through continuous lending and providing mitigation measures for borrowers.

detail.abstract: Using a sample of non-financial domestic firms in transition economies from Eastern Europe and Central Asia, we examine whether and how inter-industry spillover from FDI in the banking sector occurs. Our findings show that the innovation pursued by domestic firms benefits from foreign bank penetration. However, these positive inter-industry spillovers surprisingly do not seem to work through enhanced credit access. We further find these positive spillovers to occur mainly for foreign banks that use relationship lending, domestic firms that do not export, and host countries that are less open to the global market.

title: Move a Little Closer? Information Sharing and the Spatial Clustering of Bank Branches

detail.title: Move a Little Closer? Information Sharing and the Spatial Clustering of Bank Branches

publicationDetails.detailsText: Swiss Finance Institute Research Paper No. 17-74
publicationDetails.journalName: Swiss Finance Institute Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We present a model of credit market competition to derive key hypotheses about how information sharing between banks influences the spatial clustering of their branches. We then test these hypotheses using data on 56,555 branches owned by 614 banks across 19 countries. We find that information sharing incentivizes banks to establish branches in localities that are new to them but that are already served by other banks. The resultant branch clustering is associated with reduced spatial credit rationing, as information sharing enables firms to access credit from more distant banks. These findings underscore how information sharing makes it more important for banks to move closer to each other rather than closer to their borrowers.

title: Trial Plans as a Means of Price Discrimination
affiliations: Northwestern University - Department of Managerial Economics and Decision Sciences (MEDS)

detail.title: Trial Plans as a Means of Price Discrimination
detail.abstract:
When consumers differ in both their valuations and their likelihood of being well-matched with the product, the seller can benefit from offering trial plans as persuasion instruments to the extent of full surplus extraction. In the presence of picky consumers, those skeptical about product quality but willing to pay a premium if the product meets their standards, offering a menu of trials allows the seller to screen consumers and extract more surplus. If consumers with a higher valuation for a well matched product are more
skeptical and consumers’ expected valuation is an increasing and concave function of their probability of being well-matched, the seller can extract the full surplus by offering a menu of trial plans. This rationale for trials differs from others in the literature which are based on risk aversion or high marginal cost.

We are grateful to Deric Cheng, Justin Bullock, Robert Greer, Tyler Reinagel, Lee Lockwood, Anton Korinek, Liam Epstein, and Liam Patell for their thoughtful comments and review.

detail.abstract: Transformative artificial intelligence (TAI) will reshape how economies generate and allocate value. It poses three fundamental challenges to public finance: widespread labor displacement that erodes wage-based tax revenues, borderless economic activity that defies geographically rooted levies, and concentration of economic gains that bypasses existing taxation mechanisms. A new approach to funding government is needed. Our work assesses the performance of nine public revenue strategies across scenarios that vary in their levels of labor displacement, productivity growth, and gains concentration. To do so, we build upon traditional tax evaluation approaches and introduce the FIRI Framework (Feasibility, Incidence, Resilience, and Incentives) to handle TAI-specific concerns. We identify the most promising portfolio of policy options, pinpoint key trade-offs, and highlight where future research should focus.

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Declaration of interests ☒ The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. ☐ The authors declare the following financial interests/personal relationships which may be considered as potential competing interests:

detail.abstract: Cryptocurrency markets have matured into a distinct asset class characterized by extreme volatility, deep liquidity pools, and worldwide retail participation. Traditional equity and commodity markets exhibit a well-documented pre-holiday effect, where returns on trading days immediately preceding public holidays tend to outperform other days. Given that Bitcoin is often described as the archetypal absolute risk asset, it is natural to hypothesize that any calendardriven anomalies observed in equities should manifest-or even amplify-in crypto markets. However, unlike equity markets, where institutional investors and marketing calendars drive collective behavior, crypto markets are more dispersed, retail-dominated, and influenced by nontraditional information flows. This article investigates whether the classic pre-holiday effect applies to Bitcoin and assesses the extent to which it can be amplified by an attention-grabbing momentum filter based on local price highs.
